races.race_name: Betfred "Nifty 50" Nursery Handicap

runners.name: Greek Symphony
runners.spotlight: Led close home to make winning nursery debut at Lingfield (7f, AW) last month and was beaten under 1l when third of six off today's 2lb higher mark at Leicester (7f, good to firm) on Sunday; respected.
runners.comment: Won on nursery debut in July and was beaten under 1l when third off new mark on Sunday

runners.name: Wise And Wonderful
runners.spotlight: Displayed improvement when fairly comfortable winner of C&D (good) maiden in early July, her third start; suffered interference when midfield in big-field nursery at Glorious Goodwood a fortnight ago and is of strong interest now back in an easier race and back at this track.
runners.comment: C&D maiden winner; excused subsequent Goodwood defeat; strong claims back here

runners.name: Sequel Star
runners.spotlight: Out of a sister to 1m Group 1 winner Champers Elysees; came from the rear for fourth on debut at Newbury (6f, good to firm) in June and again ran well when third at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) last month; upped in trip for this nursery debut and enters calculations.
runners.comment: Made the frame over 6f on first two starts; enters calculations on nursery debut

runners.name: Minster Boy
runners.spotlight: Well down the field in Newbury's Super Sprint last month but began career with two promising runs, latterly when second of 18 at Newbury (6f, good to firm); upped in trip for this nursery; recenty gelded; considered.
runners.comment: Began career with two promising runs (5f/6f); defeat in Super Sprint since best overlooked

runners.name: Bincimbal
runners.spotlight: Out of a useful a well-connected 2yo winner but was probably only fourth best on merit when third in slowly run, five-runner Yarmouth novice on debut, then was beaten 20l on second start (also 7f, good to firm); significant improvement required on nursery debut.
runners.comment: May have been flattery by proximity on debut; well beaten since; improvement needed

races.race_name: Betfred "Bet Builder" EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Tansy Lane
runners.spotlight: Well-bred filly who displayed clear promise on both starts, more recently when midfield at Newmarket's July meeting (6f, good to firm); bred to be suited by the extra furlong here; leading contender in this easier race.
runners.comment: Midfield at Newmarket's July meeting (6f); leading contender in this easier race

runners.name: Diplomata
runners.spotlight: With a top stable but unable to justify prominence in the betting on first two starts, more recently when only fifth of six at Thirsk (7f, good to firm) three weeks ago.
runners.comment: With a top stable but launched career with two underwhelming runs (6f/7f)

runners.name: Secret Flite
runners.spotlight: Bettered low-key debut when fifth of nine over C&D (good to firm) last month but will need to take another step forward to pose a threat today.
runners.comment: Not disgraced when fifth of nine over C&D last month but needs more improvement today

runners.name: Desert Symphony
runners.spotlight: Out of a Listed-placed 2yo winner but a well-beaten outsider on first two outings, not looking straightforward at Sandown (7f) on latter occasion; remains best watched.
runners.comment: A well-beaten outsider on first two outings, not looking straightforward last time

races.race_name: Betfred "The Classic Bookmaker" Handicap

runners.name: Sir Garfield
runners.spotlight: Began this season with two wins, latterly when holding on by a short head to make all over C&D (good) in early July; probably doesn't have much margin for error off current mark but returns here after a respectable eighth of 26 at Glorious Goodwood (6f, good to firm) two weeks ago.
runners.comment: On fairly tough mark now but the second of this season's two wins came over C&D

runners.name: Sandscreendeliverd
runners.spotlight: Went close off slightly higher marks on consecutive starts in May (6f/5f) and comes here after two respectable 5f thirds at Lingfield (AW/turf) last month; no surprise if he features.
runners.comment: Comes here after two respectable 5f third at Lingfield, and current mark is workable

runners.name: Angel Gabriel
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 3yo; began this season with two underwhelming handicap runs but gave it a good shot from the front when third at Kempton (7f, AW) last week; drops back in trip for turf return; a possible.
runners.comment: Low-mileage 3yo; ran well from the front when third at Kempton (7f, AW) recently

runners.name: On Edge
runners.spotlight: Late-maturing 8yo who scored on seasonal debut at Chepstow (5f, good to firm) in May and posted another good effort when third at Ffos Las (6f, good) in June; remains on career-high mark but probably won't be far away.
runners.comment: Late-maturing 8yo who began this season with his two career-best efforts (5f/6f)

runners.name: Stellar Vision
runners.spotlight: Close third on handicap debut at Newmarket (7f, good) in April but finished last over that trip on next two outings, having raced too freely; gelded during subsequent 12-week break and might benefit from this drop back in trip but still comes with risk; tongue-tie added.
runners.comment: Came last on last two outings, having raced too freely; gelded since; drops back from 7f

runners.name: Kolkata Knight
runners.spotlight: Went close on seasonal debut at Wolverhampton (5f, AW) in March but largely disappointing over that trip since; too well handicapped to rule out on this return to 6f but others have more pressing claims.
runners.comment: Went close on seasonal debut in March but largely disappointing since

runners.name: Modern Times
runners.spotlight: Signed off for Tim Easterby with two good efforts in the spring and made winning stable debut at Southwell (6f, AW; first-time cheekpieces) last month; will be fine back on turf and could still have more to offer for new stable; major player.
runners.comment: Won on last month's stable debut and could have more to offer for new yard; major player

runners.name: Ruby's Profit
runners.spotlight: Developed into useful 5f performer for Newland-Insole stable last year but is yet to hit top gear after five runs this season; makes stable debut debut from a tempting mark and should be okay back at 6f but needs to have been reinvigorated by her new regime; cheekpieces removed after one use.
runners.comment: Not at best for Newland-Insole stable this season; starts off for new yard on good mark

races.race_name: Betfred "Play Fred's £5 Million" Handicap

runners.name: Gretna Dreams
runners.spotlight: Dual 1m2f winner in this month last year, latterly off mark 4lb higher than today's; yet to strike form after three starts this season but was unlucky to be brought down on second occasion, and her subsequent third of five at Yarmouth (11.5f, good to firm) was respectable; dangerous if back in the groove.
runners.comment: Dual 1m2f winner last summer; yet to strike form this year but on good mark now
runners.owner: J Sarkar, D Sarkar, O Sarkar & D Sarkar

runners.name: Mrembo
runners.spotlight: Reliable mare who gained this season's win in three-runner contest at Windsor (11.4f, good to firm) in May; suited by this C&D and will appreciate today's ease in grade; each-way claims at least.
runners.comment: Reliable mare who will appreciate today's ease in grade; each-way claims at least

runners.name: Haveagobeau
runners.spotlight: Dual AW winner who opened turf account at 22nd attempt, coming from off the pace at Lingfield (1m2f, good to firm) three weeks ago; nudged up only 2lb for that and also suited by this C&D; likely contender again.
runners.comment: Nudged up only 2lb for recent Lingfield win and also suited by this C&D

runners.name: Private Project
runners.spotlight: Gave fairly good account when third of six in basement-grade Lingfield classified (1m2f, good to firm) last month but this ten-race maiden has a rather mixed record and is probably not the percentage call here.
runners.comment: Ran well in recent Lingfield classified but not the percentage call in this stronger race

runners.name: Offiah's Boy
runners.spotlight: Back in good form on last two outings, more recently when making all for clearcut success at Lingfield (1m1f, good to firm) ten days ago; evidently in good nick but enjoyed the run of the race there and is effectively 6lb higher under 5lb penalty here.
runners.comment: Enjoyed run of the race when making all at Lingfield recently; effectively 6lb higher here

runners.name: Celtic Spirit
runners.spotlight: A maiden after seven starts but kept on for second behind Haveagobeau at Lingfield (1m2f, good to firm) three weeks ago and remains unexposed over this trip; one to consider.
runners.comment: Kept on for second behind Haveagobeau at Lingfield last month; remains unexposed over 1m2f

runners.name: All About George
runners.spotlight: Nine-race maiden; beaten under 1l when third of five (just behind next-time-out winner Offiah's Boy) at Bath (1m2f, firm) a fortnight ago but others in this line-up appeal more all the same.
runners.comment: 0-9; beaten under 1l when third of five at Bath last month but others appeal more

runners.name: Cormorant Rock
runners.spotlight: Six-race maiden who managed only fourth of six (behind Private Project) in 0-50 classified race at Lingfield (1m2f, good to firm) a fortnight ago; needs the new cheekpieces to generate some improvement.
runners.comment: Six-race maiden who needs the new cheekpieces to generate some improvement

runners.name: Pangbourne
runners.spotlight: Seven-race maiden; runner-up twice on AW in March (8.6f/9.4f) and ran well before fading into fifth on turf debut at Windsor (11.4f, good to firm) in May; dips back into Class 6 company here; has a fighting chance if tuned up after three-month break.
runners.comment: Ran well on turf debut in May and drops in grade here; a possible if tuned up after break

runners.name: Lady Margret
runners.spotlight: Safely held on first three starts for current stable (7f-9.4f) and has now been unplaced all seven starts in total; tries a new trip here; difficult to enthuse over.
runners.comment: Unplaced all seven starts; tries a new trip; difficult to enthuse over

races.race_name: Betfred "Double Delight" Handicap

runners.name: Loblolly
runners.spotlight: Yet to add to his 7f AW 2yo win but has performed well in four handicaps since returned to turf in May, most recently when seventh of 19 at Glorious Goodwood (1m, good to firm) a fortnight ago; in calmer waters here and could be a threat if first-time cheekpieces have any positive effect.
runners.comment: Not beaten far when seventh of 19 at Glorious Goodwood last month; in calmer waters here

runners.name: Chantelle
runners.spotlight: Won two 7f AW novice races during the winter and, following a break, was second of four behind Trio over C&D (good to firm) on turf debut a fortnight ago; 4lb better off with that filly today and will be hard to beat if the run brought her on.
runners.comment: Second behind Trio over C&D on last month's turf debut, after a break; good chance

runners.name: Trio
runners.spotlight: Improving filly who won twice over C&D on good to firm ground last month; raised another 5lb since beating Chantelle in four-runner race on latter occasion but still has obvious claims.
runners.comment: Improving filly who won twice over C&D on good to firm ground last month; obvious claims
runners.owner: M H Dixon & J L Rowsell

runners.name: Mystic Moment
runners.spotlight: Useful 2yo (and course winner) when trained by Eve Johnson Houghton but soundly beaten in three handicaps (7f-1m) for new stable this year; may yet turn things around for Neil Mulholland but it's probably wise to wait for some encouraging signals from the betting.
runners.comment: Useful 2yo but soundly beaten on all three starts for new stable this year

races.race_name: Betfred "Follow Us On X" Handicap

runners.name: Eyes Front
runners.spotlight: Kept on well to score over C&D (good to firm) a fortnight ago, opening his account at the 12th attempt; subsequent 3lb rise does not look excessive and he ought to be right in the thick of things again.
runners.comment: Kept on for C&D win a fortnight ago and recent 3lb rise does not look excessive

runners.name: Ice Cube
runners.spotlight: Appreciated ease in grade and justified favouritism when scoring over C&D (good to firm) four weeks ago, his ninth start; subsequent 3lb rise ought to be manageable and further progress is possible; shortlisted.
runners.comment: Scored over C&D when eased in grade last month; 3lb rise ought to be manageable

runners.name: King Of War
runners.spotlight: Front-runner who is probably best known for his exploits at Brighton; won there (7f, good to firm) in June and was placed from favourable draw at Chester (7f, good) last month but finished well down the field when last in action and might find others better treated.
runners.comment: Made all at favourite track Brighton in June; might find others better treated

runners.name: Play Me
runners.spotlight: Largely consistent 4yo who came from off the pace to win at Brighton (1m, good) in June; can be excused his recent defeat there (eased when denied clear run) but he's still on a fairly tough mark and this drop back in trip may not be ideal.
runners.comment: Won at Brighton (1m) in June; current mark is fairly tough and 7f may not be ideal for him
runners.owner: P And Mrs L Rowe And John Turner

runners.name: Spacewoman
runners.spotlight: Gained her breakthrough when dropped to 6f (from 8.3f) at Newmarket (good to firm) in June and ran at least as well when running-on third at Leicester (6f, good to firm) last month; slightly disappointing on latest outing but still considered on this move back up to 7f.
runners.comment: Gained her breakthrough over 6f in June; considered on this return to 7f

runners.name: Freddie's Star
runners.spotlight: Generally disappointing this season but seemingly aided by cheekpieces on last two outings, more recently when fourth of nine at Ffos Las (7.3f, good) last month; another 2lb lower here; each-way claims if he responds well to the new blinkers.
runners.comment: Comes here after two respectable runs in cheekpieces; now tries blinkers; each-way claims

runners.name: Red Mirage
runners.spotlight: Seven-time winner; yet to build upon his pleasing seasonal reappearance in March but ran quite well when fourth at Southwell (7f, AW) three weeks ago and switches back to turf on a good mark; can't be ruled out.
runners.comment: Ran quite well when fourth on AW last month and returns to turf on a good mark; a possible

runners.name: Ararat
runners.spotlight: 0-7 for new stable this season; outran 28-1 odds when placed at Newbury (7f, good to firm) in June and is now 4lb below that mark but his more recent efforts have been underwhelming; others preferred.
runners.comment: Outran 28-1 odds when placed at Newbury in June but recent form is underwhelming

runners.name: A La Noche
runners.spotlight: Well-bred 5yo; showed promise as a 2yo for Richard Hannon (three runs; 6f-1m) but makes stable/handicap debut after mammoth 1,059-day absence; market helpful.
runners.comment: Showed promise as a 2yo but makes stable/handicap debut after mammoth absence

races.race_name: Download The Quinnbet App "Confined" Novice Stakes (Run No More Than Twice) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Matins
runners.spotlight: 6-4 and tongue tied when easily making a winning start in four-runner maiden at Salisbury (1m, good to firm) 20 days ago, drawing clear last 1f; this son of Frankel is very hard to side against.
runners.comment: Easily made a winning start in four-runner maiden at Salisbury; very hard to side against

runners.name: Emperor Aurelius
runners.spotlight: Golden Horn colt; dam, 2m7f/3m1f hurdle winner, is a sister to 1m winner Romulan Prince; the market can prove an accurate indicator for this newcomer.
runners.comment: Golden Horn colt; the market can prove an accurate indicator for this newcomer

races.race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Mino
runners.spotlight: Built on debut sixth with his fifth of nine in 7f Doncaster novice (good to firm) 22 days ago; this son of Palace Pier is open to further progress; one to consider.
runners.comment: Built on debut with his fifth in a Doncaster novice; open to further progress; considered

runners.name: Rock Montreal
runners.spotlight: 1,000,000gns yearling; Blue Point colt; closely related to three winners, including San Donato (6f/1m Group 2; RPR 114) and Diablo Rojo (Group-placed 6f; RPR 106) and a half-brother to two winners; dam Group-placed 6f 2yo winner (RPR 102); big-money purchase who catches the eye on pedigree and holds a Group 1 Dewhurst entry; a most interesting newcomer.
runners.comment: 1,000,000gns yearling; Blue Point colt; a most interesting newcomer for leading yard

runners.name: Del Pearo
runners.spotlight: 6,000euros yearling, 26,000gns breeze-up 2yo; half-brother to six winners, notably Broxi (7f 2yo; RPR 92) and Mighty Vega (6f/7f 2yo; RPR 78); dam, well beaten over 7f/1m, is a half-sister to 1m2f Listed winner Modeyra, out of 1m2f Group 1 winner; this Persian Force colt can't be ruled out, especially if the market vibes are positive.
runners.comment: This Persian Force colt can't be ruled out, especially if the market vibes are positive

runners.name: Junior Again
runners.spotlight: 85,000gns breeze-up 2yo; dam, unraced sister to 5f winner Lufricia, is closely related to 7f 2yo Group 2 winner Hello You, out of French 7f/7.5f winning half-sister to 6.5f Group 1 winner Signs Of Blessing; this son of Baaeed is a much respected debutant for good yard.
runners.comment: This son of Baaeed is a much respected newcomer for good yard

runners.name: On Target
runners.spotlight: 5-1 and very green when an encouraging debut sixth of nine in maiden at Sandown (7f, good to firm) 22 days ago; this Sea The Stars colt can take a sizeable step forward now.
runners.comment: Very green when encouraging debut sixth at Sandown; can take a sizeable step forward now

runners.name: Stormy Winter
runners.spotlight: 15-2, looked in need of the experience when a never-dangerous fourth of six in Catterick novice (7f, good to firm) ten days ago; this Dark Angel colt is capable of better.
runners.comment: In need of initial experience when fourth at Catterick; capable of better

races.race_name: Download The QuinnBet App Handicap

runners.name: Arcturus Flame
runners.spotlight: Sole win came over 1m in April 2025; in good form this season before his form dipped when fifth of ten in 1m4f Epsom handicap last month; latest race was voided and he's left Richard Hughes since; very much one to consider in a change of headgear for his new yard.
runners.comment: In good form before his form dipped early last month; very much considered for new yard

runners.name: Divot
runners.spotlight: Took 17 runs to gain a first win, over 1m2f here in July, but followed up in another 1m2f handicap at this track 17 days ago; up 5lb but latest runner-up has gone in since, so he's not taken at all lightly in his hat-trick bid.
runners.comment: On a hat-trick after a pair of 1m2f wins here in July; up 5lb but not taken at all lightly

runners.name: Good Onya Mate
runners.spotlight: Fair form when 1m6f second for Henry de Bromhead in May; signed off for him with an encouraging hurdling fifth at Cork in July; has since changed hands for £7,000 and not out of things for his new stable.
runners.comment: Fair form when 1m6f second for Henry de Bromhead in May; not out of things for new stable

runners.name: Zachary Hickes
runners.spotlight: Australia gelding who has shown promise on each of his three runs, still looking inexperienced when fourth of seven in a 1m2f Salisbury maiden in June; that form has worked out well and he rates an interesting handicap debutant with this longer trip also a plus.
runners.comment: Australia gelding; has shown promise each of his three runs; interesting handicap debutant

races.race_name: QuinnBet Classified Stakes

runners.name: Nicely Curved
runners.spotlight: Yet to get her head in front but she comes here in good nick, third of six in 7f classified event here 12 days ago; she can go well again.
runners.comment: Yet to get her head in front but she comes here in good nick; she can go well again

runners.name: Letsbeatsepsis
runners.spotlight: Consistent sort who gained a deserved first success in 11-runner classified event at Windsor (1m2f) 11 days ago; he's just as effective over this 1m trip and weighted to go well again.
runners.comment: Deserved first success in classified event at Windsor 11 days ago; weighted to go well

runners.name: Lordsbridge Bay
runners.spotlight: Fair form when third in 1m Southwell maiden in March but his more recent form in handicaps is far less encouraging, ninth of ten at Southwell (1m3f) 22 days ago; it's easy to look elsewhere.
runners.comment: Ninth of ten at Southwell (1m3f) 22 days ago; it's easy to look elsewhere

runners.name: Castlekeely
runners.spotlight: Yet to make the frame in seven starts and only tenth of 13 in 1m2f Bath handicap in June when last seen; plenty more is needed after a break.
runners.comment: Yet to make the frame and only tenth of 13 in Bath handicap in June when last seen

runners.name: Oh So Audacious
runners.spotlight: A fair 7f scorer for Harry Eustace last August; yet to show that form for her current handler but she wasn't disgraced with fourth of six in 7f classified event here 12 days ago; not out of things.
runners.comment: Not disgraced when fourth in 7f classified event here 12 days ago; not out of things

runners.name: Poetic Grace
runners.spotlight: Looks a poor maiden on balance but mainly in good nick until just fifth of six in 7f Leicester handicap last month; needs to bounce back.
runners.comment: In good nick until fifth of six in 7f Leicester handicap last month; needs to bounce back

runners.name: Heer's Sadie
runners.spotlight: Dual winner here (including C&D) last summer; second over C&D on two of her last three starts, latterly in a handicap 17 days ago; winner has gone in again, so she's well in the mix dropped back into classified company.
runners.comment: C&D winner; good second over C&D latest; well in the mix back in classified company

runners.name: El Carrusel
runners.spotlight: 0-9 and he was retried in cheekpieces when beating one in 7f handicap here 17 days ago; others are much preferred.
runners.comment: 0-9 and he was retried in cheekpieces when beating one in 7f handicap here 17 days ago
runners.owner: The Boys Are Back In Town

runners.name: Keeper Of Secrets
runners.spotlight: Remains winless and he resumed from four months off (gelded) with a poor seventh of ten in 1m AW classified event at Lingfield last month; needs to take a big step forward.
runners.comment: Remains winless and poor seventh at Lingfield last month; needs to take a big step forward

runners.name: Dee's Honey
runners.spotlight: Has cut little ice in her three starts and beat only one in 7f novice at Chelmsford on return in March; not easy to make a case for after another layoff.
runners.comment: Has cut little ice in her three starts to date; not easy to make a case for after a break

races.race_name: QuinnBet Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap

runners.name: Zoustar Dreams
runners.spotlight: Gained a third success of 2026 in 5f handicap at Nottingham in July; not at her best when fourth of five at Ripon (5f) since; the sort to bounce back though.
runners.comment: Not at her best when fourth of five at Ripon (5f) latest; the sort to bounce back though

runners.name: Cameley Days
runners.spotlight: Scored at Windsor (5f) in May and in good form since until only 13th in 5f York handicap 20 days ago; no surprise to see her get back on track here.
runners.comment: In good form until only 13th at York 20 days ago; no surprise to see her get back on track

runners.name: Always Perfect
runners.spotlight: Opened her account in 6f handicap here in June and backed it up with a solid fourth of eight at Newbury (6f) 22 days ago; needs considering.
runners.comment: Won here in June; solid fourth at Newbury (6f) 22 days ago; needs considering

runners.name: Lazzar
runners.spotlight: A dual 6f AW winner last winter for Richard Hughes; went without usual cheekpieces when a fair fourth of seven for his new handler at Lingfield (5f) 20 days ago; not out of things.
runners.comment: Fair fourth for his new handler at Lingfield (5f) 20 days ago; not out of things

runners.name: Creative Queen
runners.spotlight: First win in 6f novice here in May; got back on track (in a change of headgear) with third of five in 5f Ripon handicap 11 days ago; blinkers (used on previous three starts) are refitted but she needs considering.
runners.comment: Back on track with third at Ripon 11 days ago; needs considering, with blinkers refitted

runners.name: Rumble Ruby
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage filly who got back on the up with success in 5f handicap at Beverley two days ago; player under a 6lb penalty in her bid for a third success of 2026.
runners.comment: Got back on the up with win at Beverley two days ago; player under a 6lb penalty

races.race_name: Danny Frost - Medlock Electrical Distributors Classified Stakes

runners.name: Valadero
runners.spotlight: Refitted with blinkers when finally gaining a first win (switched to front-running) in 7f classified event at Brighton eight days ago; a repeat of that form in retained headgear will see him firmly in the picture again.
runners.comment: First win at Brighton eight days ago; firmly in the picture if backing that form up

runners.name: Mister Sandman
runners.spotlight: Still to score but he's a reliable type and comes here after a good second of eight in 5.5f classified event at Brighton in June; recent cheekpieces are left off here (just hooded) and he can go well after a break.
runners.comment: Good second at Brighton in June; cheekpieces off (just hooded) and he can go well

runners.name: Mayflower Rock
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced filly who belatedly built on earlier promise with third of six in 5f classified event here nine days ago, staying on late; this return to 6f promises to suit, so she's a player.
runners.comment: Good third here nine days ago; this return to 6f promises to suit, so she's a player

runners.name: My Mate Mackley
runners.spotlight: Landed a 5f Chepstow handicap in May and mainly in good form since, this week finishing runner-up in a 6f handicap there on Sunday and winning a 6f classified at Lingfield (AW; did it readily) yesterday evening; 7lb claimer takes over; must enter calculations.
runners.comment: Won a Chepstow handicap in May and Lingfield classified yesterday; must be in calculations

runners.name: Red Legs
runners.spotlight: Low-level form in her three runs and she came last of four in 5f Leicester novice 23 days ago; much more is required here.
runners.comment: Last of four in 5f Leicester novice 23 days ago; much more is required here

runners.name: Bullington Bry
runners.spotlight: Failed to build on an encouraging Leicester 6f second (debut for new yard) when just sixth of 11 in 6f Pontefract handicap 19 days ago; he's now 0-23.
runners.comment: Failed to build on Leicester 6f second (yard debut) when sixth at Pontefract; now 0-23

runners.name: My Mate Beattie
runners.spotlight: Yet to register a win after 26 outings; got right back on track with third of nine in 6f Ffos Las handicap 17 days ago, though, so needs considering.
runners.comment: Good third of nine in 6f Ffos Las handicap 17 days ago, so this maiden needs considering

runners.name: Payforanother Daay
runners.spotlight: Capable of some fair form but this low-mileage 6yo has yet to offer much in three runs this summer and failed to beat a rival in five-runner handicap at Bath (5.5f) two weeks ago; blinkers go on for the first time.
runners.comment: Yet to offer much in three runs this summer; blinkers go on for the first time

runners.name: Thanks Dad
runners.spotlight: Both his wins have come at Southwell (6f/7f, AW) and he's offered little in three 6f/7f handicaps on turf this summer; others are preferred.
runners.comment: Both wins on AW and he's offered little in three 6f/7f handicaps on turf this summer

races.race_name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden

runners.name: Arrowstock
runners.spotlight: Modest enough run on debut in a 5f maiden at Navan, ran a very respectable race when set a stiff task in a 5f Listed event at Naas, form boosted Hanney Boy in a maiden, and more tellingly by Big Negotiator in a Listed race; 6f may have stretched her stamina when she faded into fourth in a 17-runner Navan contest.
runners.comment: Coped well when highly tried in a Listed race, confirmed a fair standard of form at Navan

runners.name: Walk On Harry
runners.spotlight: Fifth of 10 in a Naas barrier trial and ran respectably in a strong 6f Curragh maiden on debut; encouraging third over C&D last month, though did not have much to spare over Best Love; tongue-tie may help to produce improvement.
runners.comment: Ran in a good Curragh maiden, encouraging third over C&D last month, tongue-tie may help

runners.name: Southern Boulevard
runners.spotlight: Improved from debut at Naas when third behind her shorter-priced stablemate La Tache at the Curragh; winner has since finished fourth in C&D conditions event; should not be far away.
runners.comment: Improved from debut when third to a shorter-priced stablemate at the Curragh, good chance

runners.name: Better Yet
runners.spotlight: Second foal; half-sister by Lucky Vega to a winner in Italy; dam a 5f 2yo winner by Frankel, closely related to a Listed-placed German 7f winner.
runners.comment: Second foal, half-sister by Lucky Vega to a winner in Italy, dam a 5f winner by Frankel

runners.name: Best Love
runners.spotlight: Towards the rear on debut in a Curragh maiden; swerved and unseated rider early on next time at Down Royal; only a neck behind the shorter-priced Walk On Harry over C&D; should be competitive.
runners.comment: Only a neck behind the shorter-priced Walk On Harry over C&D, should be competitive

runners.name: Eagle Eclipse
runners.spotlight: Half-brother by Blue Point to two winners for this stable and one in France; unraced dam closely related to Derby/Gold Cup second Dee Ex Bee; bought back for E150,000 as a yearling.
runners.comment: Half-brother by Blue Point to two winners for this stable and one in France

runners.name: Syrah
runners.spotlight: First foal; Invincible Army filly; dam had poor form at 6f, sister to a winner in France, half-sister to two 6f winners.
runners.comment: First foal, Invincible Army filly, dam had poor form at 6f, sister to a winner in France,

runners.name: Give Me Liberty
runners.spotlight: Beaten in excess of 20l in his first three races; detached last of six over 7f at Down Royal four weeks ago; ruled out.
runners.comment: Beaten in excess of 20l in his first three races, last of six at Down Royal, ruled out

runners.name: Annie Tips
runners.spotlight: Dropped away to finish in rear when 66-1 for her debut in a 6f Fairyhouse maiden.
runners.comment: Dropped away to finish in rear when 66-1 for her debut in a 6f Fairyhouse maiden

runners.name: My Irish Lady
runners.spotlight: Has finished with only one behind her in each of her two races; well held by Southern Boulevard; safe to rule out
runners.comment: Has finished with only one behind her in each of her two races, not likely to feature

runners.name: Ocean Surge
runners.spotlight: Slowly away when well beaten over 6f at this venue on her debut; others more likely.
runners.comment: Slowly away when well beaten over 6f at this venue on her debut, others more likely

runners.name: Dhikola
runners.spotlight: Has struggled in outings at Navan (eased, excuses offered) and the Curragh, when he still looked raw; gelded now; best watched.
runners.comment: Has struggled in outings at Navan (excuses) and the Curragh, best watched
runners.owner: Walerc Limited/M J Wasylocha/Tony Cantwell/Paul J Nolan

runners.name: Stormy Dawn
runners.spotlight: Dropped away to finish at the back in a 7f maiden at Leopardstown; unlikely to feature.
runners.comment: Dropped away to finish at the back in a 7f maiden at Leopardstown, unlikely to feature

runners.name: Invincible Irish
runners.spotlight: Failed to recover from a slow start on debut at the Curragh; three-figure odds then.
runners.comment: Failed to recover from a slow start on debut at the Curragh, three-figure odds then

runners.name: Always Magic
runners.spotlight: Finished with only one behind him when 25-1 chance on debut at Fairyhouse; has been gelded; does not appeal.
runners.comment: Finished with only one behind him when 25-1 chance on debut, gelded now, does not appeal

runners.name: Nando The Great
runners.spotlight: Completely ignored in the betting at the Curragh on Sunday; broke slowly, always behind.
runners.comment: Completely ignored in the betting at the Curragh on Sunday, broke slowly, always behind

races.race_name: OCS Recruitment Handicap

runners.name: The Right One
runners.spotlight: Several placings last year; off the mark on seasonal return over this trip on soft ground at Down Royal in first-time cheekpieces; got upset in the stalls in the Navan race dominated by several of these rivals.
runners.comment: Soft-ground Down Royal winner, got upset in the stalls in race won by Another Nice'Day

runners.name: Amerilis
runners.spotlight: Ran twice for Paddy Twomey at two; runner-up in two of her three handicap starts, notably behind the ultra-progressive Meriden at the Curragh in June; last month's Navan run can be upgraded slightly since she became unbalanced after briefly hitting the front; closely matched with Cashel Blue, both could cope with the winner Another Nice'Day on these terms.
runners.comment: Closely matched with Cashel Blue, both could cope with Another Nice'Day on these terms

runners.name: Gonna Be Golden
runners.spotlight: Won 7f fillies' maiden at Dundalk last December; fair third behind The Right One at Down Royal on her first 5f attempt; more recent form over 7f at Dundalk and 5f at the Curragh is less encouraging.
runners.comment: Ran well behind The Right One over 5f at Down Royal, more recent form is less encouraging

runners.name: Lady Landhort
runners.spotlight: Sole success came in 6f Dundalk handicap in March off 49; placed over 5f at the same venue in April; has changed stable since finishing fifth behind Cashel Blue at Down Royal in May; her new trainer also saddles top weight Kiss Don't Tell.
runners.comment: Winner and placed at Dundalk, fifth behind Cashel Blue at Down Royal, has changed stable
runners.owner: T J Flanagan & Ronan Macken & Shane McSweeney & S O'Malley

runners.name: Love Bomb
runners.spotlight: Won nursery over 5f on yielding at Down Royal last September off 17lb higher; unplaced in 11 starts since then; signs that her decline may have been arrested when fourth of 19 over 6f at this venue three weeks ago; should not be written off.
runners.comment: 5f nursery winner at Down Royal, best 2026 effort over 6f at this venue three weeks ago

runners.name: Another Nice'day
runners.spotlight: Built on a promising sixth of 21 at Naas to get off the mark at Navan (5f, good), beating today's rivals Amerilis and Cashel Blue, despite being out of the handicap; out of the money at Naas 11 days ago.
runners.comment: Beat Amerilis and Cashel Blue at Navan when out of the handicap, out of the money at Naas

runners.name: Sceitimini
runners.spotlight: Best of three handicaps run over this trip at Dundalk in January, beaten only 2l in fifth despite not getting a clear run; in rear at Bellewstown six weeks ago; looked unwilling on the way to post and missed the break, last of 13; hard to be confident.
runners.comment: Best of three handicaps run over this trip at Dundalk, in rear at Bellewstown last time

runners.name: Cashel Blue
runners.spotlight: Off the mark on handicap debut at Down Royal in June, with Lady Landhort and Love Bomb among her victims; went up 6lb for that and was right in the mix when third behind Another Nice'Day and Amerilis at Navan; one of the leading contenders.
runners.comment: Went up 6lb for Down Royal win, rematch of Navan clash with Another Nice'Day and Amerilis

runners.name: Lilbittyprettyone
runners.spotlight: Modest form in three 5f outings at two; never involved over 1m at Dundalk last month; has a great deal to prove now.
runners.comment: Modest form in three 5f outings at two, never involved over 1m at Dundalk last month

runners.name: Simmering Seas
runners.spotlight: Now making her first appearance for her third trainer; hard to make a strong case for her following a moderate run at Bellewtown in April; Naas run on seasonal debut was better.
runners.comment: Now making her first appearance for her third trainer, hard to make a strong case for her

runners.name: Kiss Don't Tell
runners.spotlight: Debut Curragh run was low-key but much better at Naas (6f, good) last August, showing early speed and beaten just 4l into fifth of 12; ended the campaign with a promising 5f AW effort, second to an odd-on chance; could go close if fit and ready for return.
runners.comment: Ended last year with a promising 5f AW effort, could go close if fit and ready for return

runners.name: Smart Sioux
runners.spotlight: Best run when staying-on sixth in Naas fillies' maiden over 5f last summer; has shown next to nothing in handicaps; transformation needed to feature here.
runners.comment: Has shown next to nothing in handicaps, transformation needed to feature here

races.race_name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Firville Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies)

runners.name: Alwaysanangel
runners.spotlight: Wore tongue-tie when scoring readily on debut at Fairyhouse (6f, good); aimed high only nine days later in the Group 2 Duchess Of Cambridge Stakes at Newmarket (6f, good to firm); the form of her third looks rock-solid; winner was the Queen Mary second Senorita Bonita, runner-up was Libertango, who beat subsequent Group 1 winner Sun Goddess in the Albany Stakes.
runners.comment: Excellent third behind two top fillies in a Newmarket Group 2 nine days after debut win

runners.name: Beibhinn
runners.spotlight: Beat subsequent Listed winner Big Negotiator and today's rival Madam Secretary in a Listowel maiden in May; third to subsequent Group 1 winner Sun Goddess at the Curragh before a below-par run in France; cheekpieces added now; champion jockey prefers Alwaysanangel.
runners.comment: Third to Sun Goddess before below-par run in France, champion jockey prefers Alwaysanangel

runners.name: Nevermindtherain
runners.spotlight: Held by Maire Rua on maiden form, and already had two races under her belt at that stage; made the running for smart stablemate Alpha in a 7f Group 3 at Leopardstown; raised 13lb to a mark of 98 that should make her competitive here in theory.
runners.comment: Held by Maire Rua on maiden form, made the running for smart stablemate Alpha in a Group 3
runners.owner: Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith

runners.name: Madam Secretary
runners.spotlight: Apprentice-ridden when 5l third of eight behind Beibhinn in a maiden at Listowel in May; third in a 7f maiden at Newmarket last month; hard to be confident now after a third maiden defeat at Galway.
runners.comment: Promising maiden, debatable whether she can reverse Listowel form with Beibhinn
runners.owner: Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier

runners.name: Celtic Moon
runners.spotlight: Improved from her Leopardstown debut on soft to win a 1m Bellewstown maiden on good ground;  in rear in a nursery at Galway; 75-rated filly faces a huge task in this grade.
runners.comment: Maiden winner over 1m at Bellewstown, in rear in a nursery, faces huge task in this grade

runners.name: Maire Rua
runners.spotlight: Third foal; sister to the trainer's Group 3-winning filly Red Letter (Group 1-placed in the Pretty Polly) and yard's maiden winner Res Ipsa; justified a good home reputation when scoring readily on debut at Leopardstown (7f, good), despite showing a degree of inexperience; should not be out of place in this grade.
runners.comment: Justified a good home reputation when scoring on debut at Leopardstown, deserves respect

runners.name: Alpine Wedding
runners.spotlight: Improved from Leopardstown debut when third at the Curragh, just in front of disappointing favourite Ibelieveicanfly who has since made amends; faces a tough task against the winners.
runners.comment: Improved from Leopardstown debut when third at the Curragh, tough task against winners

runners.name: Damsel In Distress
runners.spotlight: Looked in need of further when staying on in a Listowel maiden over an extended 6f, beaten 14l in fifth behind Beibhinn; now has a lot more on her plate than winning a maiden over an extended 7f at Roscommon in June.
runners.comment: A lot more on her plate than winning a maiden at Roscommon in June

runners.name: Shi Yang
runners.spotlight: Long-priced Curragh maiden winner on her third outing; on the upgrade but this looks too demanding for an 80-rated filly.
runners.comment: Long-priced Curragh maiden winner on her third outing, this looks too demanding

races.race_name: NFP Irish EBF Platinum Stakes (Listed Race)

runners.name: Carolina Jetstream
runners.spotlight: Four-time winner on AW; 0-7 on turf but has performed well on two occasions this year; 66-1, made much of the running when second of 12 in a 1m Group 2 at the Curragh in May; raced prominently before fading into fifth (of 15) in the Duke of Cambridge Stakes at Royal Ascot; out of her depth in a 1m2f Group 1 on latest; possibly best at 1m, good chance all the same.
runners.comment: All four wins on AW, out of her depth in a 1m2f Group 1 on latest, possibly best at 1m
runners.owner: AMO Racing Limited & Giselle De Aguiar

runners.name: Spinning Around
runners.spotlight: Won a 7f Dundalk nursery last October and gained another win over the same trip in a Curragh fillies' handicap in May; respectable run in the Sandringham Handicap at Royal Ascot; held her own when fifth at Killarney in her first race at this level.
runners.comment: Useful handicapper, held her own when fifth at Killarney in her first race at this level
runners.owner: Mrs M V Magnier,Mrs O'Loughlin,Mrs Byrne

runners.name: Tahcawin
runners.spotlight: Fairyhouse nursery winner last season; showed significant improvement to finish third in a Group 3 over 6f at Naas in May; not at the same level in two subsequent Listed attempts; stable got back to winning form at Galway; tongue-tie on now.
runners.comment: Winner and Group 3-placed at 6f, stable got back to winning form at Galway

runners.name: Princess Child
runners.spotlight: Group 3 winner at Tipperary (7.5f, yielding) at the end of last summer; matched that form when second in 1m Group 3 at the Curragh in April (soft/heavy); below-par on her two most recent starts, including in a Curragh Group 2 event in which Carolina Jetstrean was second; might prefer an ease.
runners.comment: Useful mare at her best, below-par on her two most recent starts, might prefer an ease

runners.name: Treasure Rose
runners.spotlight: Series of placings in maidens; made an immediate impact in handicaps, winning at Down Royal (7f, soft) and back at 6f when getting up late at Fairyhouse on quicker ground; competed admirably when stepped up to this grade over 6f at Naas.
runners.comment: Progressive in handicaps, coped admirably when stepped up to this grade over 6f at Naas

runners.name: Suzie Songs
runners.spotlight: Looked potentially smart last year, winning Group 3 at the Curragh and finishing runner-up in the Group 2 Debutante; first two runs this term well below that level, too free in Group 3 at Leopardstown and never landed a blow when fourth of six behind L L Koulsty in a rated race at Naas; got a confidence-boosting win when accounting for Fort Vega last time.
runners.comment: Smart juvenile last year, took a while to retrieve form this term, beat Fort Vega at Naas

runners.name: Keke
runners.spotlight: Has recorded six of his eight wins over 5f, including last year's Rockingham Handicap; twice successful at 6f; now attempting this trip for the first time; has run well in Listed sprints this term and won a Naas conditions event before a creditable fourth of 20 in the Scurry Handicap at the Curragh.
runners.comment: Six of his eight wins at 5f, the other two at 6f, attempting this trip for the first time

runners.name: Sindagan
runners.spotlight: Showed promise in making the frame in two starts last autumn; beaten favourite when second at Naas on seasonal debut; eased up late for third at Gowran; rated 83 before chasing home the long odds-on Bamako Beach at Fairyhouse; did not need to improve much from that to win at Galway; more needed now.
runners.comment: Did not need to improve much from her Fairyhouse second to win at Galway, more needed now
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan

runners.name: L L Koulsty
runners.spotlight: C&D handicap winner on very soft ground in May; dug deep to win a Naas conditions event, with Suzie Songs back in fourth; that rival is much better suited by the race conditions now.
runners.comment: C&D handicap winner on very soft ground in May, dug deep to win a Naas conditions event

runners.name: Nancy J
runners.spotlight: Won a 2yo maiden on debut for Jessica Harrington; ran some good races in defeat last year; joined Johnny Murtagh this term; fair fourth behind Meriden at the Curragh in June; did well to finish third of six in a 7f Group 3 race at Leopardstown; however, that looked a sub-standard affair; failed to land a blow at Galway last time.
runners.comment: Probably flattered by her promotion to 95 for her third in a 7f Group 3 at Leopardstown

runners.name: Fort Vega
runners.spotlight: Good form last season, winning C&D premier handicap (good) and second in the Scurry Handicap at the Curragh; matched that effort when beaten a neck in the same venue's Habitat Handicap on seasonal return in May; solid third over C&D before losing out to Suzie Songs in a three-runner Naas contest; has never run in a stakes race, worth a shot.
runners.comment: C&D handicap winner, generally reliable sort, has never run in a stakes race, worth a shot

runners.name: Temperance
runners.spotlight: Handicap winner over 6f last season; nothing to suggest she can play a featuring part in a race of this standard.
runners.comment: Handicap winner over 6f last season, nothing to suggest she can play a featuring part

races.race_name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Give Thanks Stakes (Group 3) (Fillies & Mares)

runners.name: Amelia Earhart
runners.spotlight: Leopardstown (1m, y) maiden winner started off season in promising fashion with impressive Cheshire Oaks (1m3f, good) victory; well beat when sent off favourite for Epsom Oaks and limit has probably been found since with fifth place finishes in Irish Oaks and Lillie Langtry; that form still puts her in with a winning chance down in grade.
runners.comment: Cheshire Oaks winner has since found her limit in Group 1s but clear claims down in class
runners.owner: Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith

runners.name: Nyra
runners.spotlight: Group 3 winner in Germany and placed in German Oaks last year; built on stable debut when 0.5l second to Sparan Nua in Munster Oaks (Bosphorus Rose, third) over C&D and respectable run when beaten 3.75l into third over 1m2f (good to firm) at the Curragh 27 days ago; step back up in trip a positive and meets Bosphorus Rose on 3lb better terms, albeit that rival has since improved; stable's first-string and should go close.
runners.comment: Good second in Munster Oaks; respectable third in G3 lto but step up in trip bound to suit

runners.name: Bosphorus Rose
runners.spotlight: Four-time winner in Britain has made a very positive start with this stable, finishing third over C&D in Munster Oaks after 206 days off before producing clear career best when bolting up by 4.75l in Listed Lenebane Stakes at Roscommon (1m4f, good) 45 days ago, making all; proving progressive and is capable of taking this step up in grade in her stride; leading chance for last year's winning stable.
runners.comment: Very positive two runs for this stable; career best in Listed win lto; leading chance

runners.name: Cameo
runners.spotlight: Lingfield Oaks Trial (11.5f, good to firm) winner in May; hasn't gone on from that, well-held in Epsom and Irish Oaks in between being beaten 5.25l in Naas Group 3 (Caught U Sleeping, second); needs more.
runners.comment: Lingfield Oaks Trial winner in May; not built on that since in three starts; needs more
runners.owner: M Tabor & D Smith & Mrs J Magnier & Westerberg

runners.name: Caught U Sleeping
runners.spotlight: Naas Oaks trial winner (10.3f, good); built on that since with a neck second to Rebel Moon at Naas and shaped well from off the pace when stepped up to this trip at Newmarket last time, finishing third beaten 5.75l by Tattycoram; caught the eye with how she hit the line that day and should go well.
runners.comment: Naas Oaks Trial winner; shaped well on first go over this trip at Newmarket; claims

runners.name: Believed
runners.spotlight: Progressive type who got off the mark with an 8.5l maiden win at Dundalk (1m4f) in May before an excellent third in King George V handicap at Ascot (two in front have won since); looked unsuited by emphasis on speed when beaten favourite in Listed company at Gowran Park 20 days ago; a big player, especially if granted stronger gallop.
runners.comment: Progressive; third in strong Royal Ascot h'cap; beaten fav lto in messy race; big chance

runners.name: Snapretend
runners.spotlight: Acquitted herself well in stakes company this season, finishing a 0.5l second to subsequent Group 3 winner Moody in Listed contests over C&D (soft) and at Gowran Park (1m6f, good/yielding); respectable run when sixth in strong renewal of Orby Stakes 83 days ago; ew claims back against own sex; firm ground a possible negative.
runners.comment: Consistent type, second to subsequent G3 winner Moody twice; ew claims

runners.name: Ankara
runners.spotlight: Dual winner in France on ground with cut; shaped well on stable debut after nine months off when third in fillies handicap at Killarney (1m3f, good) 31 days ago; likely to build on that but has plenty to find with these rivals; stable has better claims with other two.
runners.comment: Dual winner on ground with cut in France; positive stable debut lto; plenty to find
runners.owner: P J O'Brien & Mrs M V Magnier & Mrs P Shanahan & K Blake

runners.name: Ice Dancer
runners.spotlight: Gowran Park maiden winner on heavy and Group 3 placed as a 2yo; finished last on all four starts this term and probably destined for pacemaking duties.
runners.comment: Finished last on all four starts this term; probable pace angle
runners.owner: Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier

races.race_name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden

runners.name: Chosen One
runners.spotlight: Ran well in two strong maidens at Naas over 1m and took another step forward upped in trip when rallying to regain second at Down Royal (10.5f, good) 28 days ago; form of that maiden doesn't look overly strong but she's gradually improving with each start and cheekpieces could help.
runners.comment: Improved up in distance when 0.75l second lto; gradually improving; cheekpieces on
runners.owner: Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith

runners.name: Garden Party
runners.spotlight: Well-bred filly who ran to a similar level when second at Leopardstown (7f, y) and Galway (7f, soft) as a 2yo; beaten odds-on fav in latter but form has a nice look to it as winner was second in Chester Vase and third has placed at Listed level; up significantly in trip off a 291-day break and fast ground an unknown but still the one to beat.
runners.comment: Second in two 7f maidens last year; up in trip off 291-day break; one to beat

runners.name: Serendipia
runners.spotlight: Well-bred filly (dam a Group 1 winner) produced her best run yet on fourth start at Gowran Park 20 days ago, running on well late to be beaten 3.25l into third; shapes as if this step up in trip will be right up her street and she's in the mix.
runners.comment: Well-bred filly; best run yet lto when never-nearer third; step up in trip bound to suit

runners.name: Zadawa
runners.spotlight: Built on debut fourth at Gowran Park when beaten 2l into third by subsequent winner Wyman at the Curragh 49 days ago (Saxony Charms behind); moved into the race well and likely more to come; hood goes on; interesting.
runners.comment: Shaped nicely when third to subsequent winner lto; interesting in first-time hood
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan

runners.name: Fairylike
runners.spotlight: Lord Kanaloa filly; dam 1m 2yo/1m6f Group 3 winner (RPR 109), sister to winners Capri (Irish Derby/St Leger), Tower Of London (1m6f/2m Group 2), Cypress Creek (2m Group 3), Brazil (useful 2m hurdle) and to dam of Fillies' Mile winner Commissioning; newcomer hails from top yard and a top-class staying family; Ryan Moore sides with Garden Party.
runners.comment: Dam 1m 2yo/1m6f G3 winner, sister four winners, inc Capri; from top-class staying family
runners.owner: Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith

runners.name: The Blonde Lady
runners.spotlight: Kew Gardens filly; dam unraced, out of unraced half-sister to winners Pasar Silbano (US 6f Grade 3), Gerfalcon (6f 2yo Listed) and Come To Heel (useful 5f/6f 2yo); yard not known for maiden winners.
runners.comment: Dam half-sister to three 6f winners, inc G3 and Listed; yard not known for maiden winners

runners.name: Trumph
runners.spotlight: Virtually tailed off at Galway 14 days ago; huge improvement required.
runners.comment: Virtually tailed off at Galway 14 days ago; huge improvement required

runners.name: Salamina
runners.spotlight: Sottsass filly; half-sister to 1m2f winner War Supremo (RPR 81); dam placed 10.6f-2m AW (75), closely related to 7f Group 3 winner Glowing, half-sister to useful 10.6f winner The Anvil, out of half-sister to 1m1f-1m2f Group 1/Grade 1 winner Beat Hollow; will need to be smart to make a winning debut against more experienced rivals; market can guide.
runners.comment: Sottsass filly, half-sister to 1m2f winner War Supremo (RPR 81); market can guide

runners.name: Elusive In Mayo
runners.spotlight: Beaten 25l on debut at Galway 14 days ago; down in trip and no obvious sign she's capable of winning a maiden on that run.
runners.comment: Beaten 25l on debut at Galway 14 days ago; down in trip and needs a lot more

runners.name: Emily Estherfaye
runners.spotlight: Showed a bit of ability before fading markedly at Galway on debut; drop in trip likely to suit but likely to find this tough.
runners.comment: Showed a bit of ability before fading on debut; likely to find this tough

runners.name: Quinchy Lady
runners.spotlight: Beaten one rival home in two starts; can't make a case for.
runners.comment: Beaten one rival home in two starts; can't make a case for

races.race_name: Fitzgerald Construction Building "A" Rated Homes Handicap

runners.name: Borora Aura
runners.spotlight: Made the frame in a couple of claimers but struggled back in a handicap at this track over 1m4f last month; positive run when sixth in Sligo claimer since but a 6lb rise reads as very harsh; doesn't appeal as well treated.
runners.comment: Decent sixth in a claimer nine days ago but 6lb higher mark a tough ask

runners.name: Glamazon
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at 11th attempt in 1m1f Ballinrobe maiden in May but hasn't made much of an impact in handicaps; decent effort when fourth at Bellewstown over this trip but weakened into ninth in claimer at Killarney 30 days ago; could bounce back now given more of a chance by the handicapper.
runners.comment: Ballinrobe maiden winner; good fourth at Bellewstown but below-par lto; can bounce back

runners.name: Imnotleavinyou
runners.spotlight: Off the mark in 7f handicap at Limerick in June; found progress stalling off 7lb higher mark since; fast ground a possible negative; up in trip.
runners.comment: 7f h'cap winner at Limerick; okay run at Galway lto but fast ground a negative

runners.name: Dawn Flame
runners.spotlight: AW winner over this trip in January; bounced back to form of late with three solid efforts, doing best work late on each time; step up in trip could be key and he should be winning off this mark soon.
runners.comment: Shaped well last three times, doing best work late; step up to 1m could be the key

runners.name: Thompson Gunner
runners.spotlight: Consistent on the AW over the winter and spring, landing handicap over 10.5f in January; whether he's as effective on turf is questionable given he hasn't troubled the judge in eight starts on it; beaten 3l when third of 16 over 9.5f at Gowran on Wednesday.
runners.comment: Decent form on the AW but question whether he's as effective on turf; third two days ago

runners.name: Starflow
runners.spotlight: Well held on handicap debut 74 days ago; needs drop in trip and blinkers to spark something.
runners.comment: Well-held on h'cap debut 74 days ago; drops in trip with blinkers tried

runners.name: Launch Time
runners.spotlight: Two wins have come at Leopardstown, latest eight days ago in first-time visor when defeating Jazzit by 0.5l; 4lb rise fair and is a winner over this trip so stepping back up in distance may bring about further improvement; leading player.
runners.comment: Improved in first-time visor to land Leop h'cap eight days ago; leading chance 4lb higher

runners.name: Reponse Finale
runners.spotlight: First reserve; moderate form in 20 starts for Kevin Smith; much improved on stable debut when  ready winner over 9.5f at Gowran Park on Wednesday; 7lb penalty.
runners.comment: First reserve; moderate form for Kevin Smith; won over 9.5f at Gowran Park on Wednesday

runners.name: James Henry
runners.spotlight: Dual AW winner who is 0-17 on turf; encouraging stable debut when third at Listowel but hasn't built on that the last twice; needs more
runners.comment: Dual AW winner; shaped well on stable debut at Listowel; below that since; needs more

runners.name: Peig Sayers
runners.spotlight: Slight positives to be taken from last two starts but overall form is weak and she needs significant improvement to display winning potential.
runners.comment: Bit better over 7f at Fairyhouse but largely struggled in 1m h'caps; up against it

runners.name: Mountain Memory
runners.spotlight: Mild promise in maidens and ran no sort of race on handicap debut at Dundalk 33 days ago; tongue-strap on and hard to expect much.
runners.comment: Ran no race on h'cap debut at Dundalk 33 days ago; tongue-strap on

runners.name: Winston's Promise
runners.spotlight: Moderate form in three maiden runs; hood on for handicap debut; market can guide.
runners.comment: Moderate form in three maidens; hard to assess on h'cap debut from low mark; hood

runners.name: Lorr's Girl
runners.spotlight: Only win and runner-up effort of her 26-race career have come at this track; landed 7f handicap off 7lb higher here in September 2024 and was second over 6f 13 months ago; largely out of form since but was only beaten 5l at Naas 23 days ago; dangerous off a basement mark and can't dismiss at her favourite track.
runners.comment: Only win and runner-up effort came at this track; slipped to a nice mark; can't dismiss

runners.name: Leannespour
runners.spotlight: Nothing worth noting in maidens but improved on handicap debut, shaping well when keeping on steadily to grab fourth over 7f on good at Gowran Park 20 days ago; step up in trip sure to suit and should go close off unchanged mark.
runners.comment: Keeping-on third on h'cap debut over 7f lto; step up in trip to suit and interesting

runners.name: Mullacash Buzz
runners.spotlight: On a long losing run but has run well from the front the last twice, most notably at Naas last time in a race he set up for closers; could be dangerous if allowed dictate but stall 16 is problematic.
runners.comment: Long losing run but consistent of late; likes to lead but stall 16 could be tricky

runners.name: Morning Approach
runners.spotlight: 1-44 on turf; step in right direction when sixth at Leopardstown last month but below that form last twice; on a nice mark but hard to trust at present.
runners.comment: Step in right direction when sixth at Leop but two poor runs since; hard to trust

runners.name: Half Cut
runners.spotlight: Has beaten just a handful of rivals in three maiden starts; drops in trip in first-time cheekpieces off a low mark on handicap debut.
runners.comment: Beat a handful of rivals in three maidens; market support would be notable on h'cap bow

races.race_name: Chapel Down Apprentice Handicap

runners.name: We Ride At Dawn
runners.spotlight: Promising second at Windsor (1m2f, good to firm) in June; not so good at Bath next time but she dipped back into her earlier promise with a dominant success at Sandown (1m2f, good to firm) three weeks ago; still has more to offer and she is a major player despite the 5lb rise.
runners.comment: Dominant success at Sandown last month; up 5lb but she should have a fair bit more to come

runners.name: Raintown
runners.spotlight: He had been threatening prior to his C&D win in an amateur riders' race three weeks ago; a 3lb rise shouldn't prevent another big run.
runners.comment: Off the mark for the year in a C&D handicap three weeks ago; in the mix once again
runners.owner: Ms Caroline Instone & J S Moore

runners.name: Living In Hope
runners.spotlight: Failed to improve for the switch to handicaps when down the field at Epsom (1m2f, good to firm) five weeks ago; this more conventional track can help, as may the addition of headgear, and she was sent off at just 5-1 last time; inexperienced apprentice on board.
runners.comment: This conventional track may suit better than Epsom last time; unexposed; now gets headgear

runners.name: Grey Fox
runners.spotlight: Course winner; ran his best race of the season when narrowly pipped at Windsor (1m2f, good to firm) last month; 1lb rise is manageable but a tactical race wouldn't play to his strengths.
runners.comment: Course winner; close second at Windsor last month; wouldn't want a tactical event

races.race_name: TPT Fire Supports St Michaels Hospice EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Dontlookbackinanga
runners.spotlight: Promising fourth of ten, beaten 3l, in a novice at Sandown (7f, good) six weeks ago; that is the best form on offer and he should stay this extra furlong judged on his pedigree.
runners.comment: Promising fourth at Sandown (7f, good) six weeks ago; sets the standard with more to come

runners.name: Quicken Away
runners.spotlight: 500,000gns yearling; fourth foal; brother to 10.3f winner Gallantly (RPR 93); dam a well-related 6f/1m winner (including French 1,000 Guineas; 113); lots to like on paper.
runners.comment: 500,000gns brother to 10.3f winner Gallantry out of French 1000 Guineas winner; contender

runners.name: Sockdolager
runners.spotlight: 90,000gns yearling; fourth foal; half-brother to 1m 2yo/1m2f winner Qitaal (RPR 93); unraced dam closely related to 1m2f Group 2 winner Bangkok, half-sister to 1m2f Group 1 winner Matterhorn and to dam of top miler Ribchester; the betting is usually an accurate guide where newcomers from the stable are concerned.
runners.comment: 90,000gns half-brother to useful Qitaal (RPR 93); betting should be a good guide

runners.name: Camelot Castle
runners.spotlight: 90,000euros yearling, resold 50,000gns yearling; tenth foal; half-brother to five winners including Shamida (1m4f/1m6f including Group 3; RPR 109), Shajak (12.5f Flat, 99; 2m hurdle) and Shemda (1m; 91); dam 1m4f winner (80), half-sister to 1m2f/1m7f Group 3 winner Shemima; bred to have a future and his trainer is in good form; betting to guide.
runners.comment: 50,000gns half-brother to five winners (including Group 3); betting should guide

runners.name: Mulvaney's Return
runners.spotlight: Ninth foal; half-brother to four winners including Fox Vardy (11.4f/1m4f; RPR 99), Kurakka (1m2f AW/1m4f turf; 96) and Midsummer Dance (French 15.5f); dam 1m 2yo winner (87), closely related to 1m2f Group 1 winner Diamondsandrubies; market support would look significant.
runners.comment: Half-brother to 4 winners including Fox Vardy (RPR 99) and Kurakka (96); betting to guide

runners.name: Rupert The Brave
runners.spotlight: Ended up a well-beaten ninth of 13 at Goodwood (7f, good to firm) on his recent debut but he shaped better than that might indicate, seeing little daylight as the race was unfolding; can do better.
runners.comment: Met trouble in running at Goodwood 13 days ago and that run can be upgraded; can do better

runners.name: King High
runners.spotlight: Smart pedigree and fetched 320,000gns as a yearling; held back by inexperience on his debut at Sandown (7f, good to firm) but showed clear signs of ability and could leave that run well behind in time.
runners.comment: Green but showed promise on last month's Sandown debut; open to plenty of improvement

races.race_name: Highclere Horse Feeds EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Sweetwonderfulyou
runners.spotlight: Easy to back but shaped with plenty of promise when third of eight at Ascot (6f, good to firm) on her debut three weeks ago, form already boosted by the runner-up; holds some fancy entries in the autumn and she is one to take seriously upped in trip.
runners.comment: Promising third at Ascot (6f, good to firm) 3 weeks ago; 7f should suit; lots more to come

runners.name: Art Of Life
runners.spotlight: Two runs in similar events here (6f-6.5f, both good to firm) this summer, improving to take second three weeks ago; 7f should be no issue and she's a leading contender.
runners.comment: Two promising course runs, latterly second over 6.5f last month; can do better still

runners.name: Isabella De Vega
runners.spotlight: Promising third at Thirsk (7f, good to firm) on her debut three weeks ago, keeping on late; open to improvement but it will be needed.
runners.comment: Promising 3rd on Thirsk debut, keeping on; can do better but she will need to

runners.name: Angel Of Desire
runners.spotlight: 25,000gns breeze-up 2yo; fourth foal; half-sister to winners Ebt's Guard (Listed-placed 1m; RPR 110) and Ziata (1m2f; 69); dam a modest maiden; likely best watched.
runners.comment: 25,000gns breeze-up 2yo; half-sister to useful winner Ebt's Guard; likely best watched

races.race_name: BetVictor Watch Weekend Winners EBF Fillies' Conditions Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Sorrengail
runners.spotlight: In need of the experience when fourth at Newmarket (6f, good to firm) on last month's debut; much more professional when seeing off seven rivals (including Sweetwonderfulyou who runs in the 4.10) at Ascot (6f, good to firm) three weeks ago; still has untapped potential.
runners.comment: Promising debut; much more professional when winning at Ascot two weeks later; big player

runners.name: Evenfall
runners.spotlight: Well-bred filly who justified odds-on favouritism in a small-field novice at Yarmouth (5f, good to firm; runner-up successful since) 22 days ago; picked up well on that occasion and the run was backed up by the Topspeed figure; this Cheveley Park entrant looks a smart prospect and should relish the sixth furlong.
runners.comment: Beat a subsequent winner in good style at Yarmouth (5f) last month; looks a smart prospect

runners.name: Coat Of Red
runners.spotlight: Promise at Goodwood on debut and made no mistake when making all in a small field at Leicester (6f, good to firm) 16 days ago; this will demand further progress.
runners.comment: Easy front-running win at Leicester 16 days ago; this contest demands a fair bit more

runners.name: Ferrystream
runners.spotlight: Knew her job when winning a 12-runner novice at Windsor (6f, good to firm; ridden by Oisin Murphy) 32 days ago; that form will need bettering in this field but she still has potential for more.
runners.comment: Debut win at Windsor needs bettering but she is bred to be smart and can improve

runners.name: Nonrem
runners.spotlight: Finished last of six in a 5f conditions event in May; takes on five previous winners here and looks up against it.
runners.comment: Last of six at Salisbury in May; looks to face a tough task in this field

races.race_name: Visit Malta St Hugh's Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies)

runners.name: Fast Track
runners.spotlight: Her first three runs were encouraging and she has proved a different proposition since a tongue-tie went on, bolting up at Beverley and then a fine second in a good conditions race at Goodwood (both 5f, good to firm); strong contender.
runners.comment: Two strong performances since fitted with a tongue-tie; leading contender

runners.name: Acting Lady
runners.spotlight: Two runs over 6f at Newmarket, finishing last of three on debut (travelled best and looked set to win 1f out) before a narrow win five weeks ago; that form looks solid and she should have more to offer; drop to 5f shouldn't be an issue.
runners.comment: Two solid efforts at Newmarket (6f, good to firm); drop to 5f shouldn't be an issue

runners.name: Acclamation Star
runners.spotlight: Came up short in two Group races after her maiden win at Bath (5.7f, firm) in May; fine second in a nursery at Newmarket (6f, good to firm) 13 days ago and that form brings her right into the reckoning; drops to 5f for the first time but she shouldn't be underestimated.
runners.comment: Fine second in a 6f Newmarket nursery 13 days ago; drops in trip but should go well

runners.name: Efsixteen
runners.spotlight: 350,000gns breeze-up purchase; created a positive impression when winning a 5f fillies' novice at Newmarket (good to firm) at the Guineas meeting and the form looks solid; her subsequent absence and the addition of a tongue-tie raise slight concerns but she looked a fine prospect in the spring.
runners.comment: 350,000gns breeze-up 2yo; looked good at Newmarket in May; absent since; now tongue tied

runners.name: Elevating
runners.spotlight: Shaped well over 6f on debut before failing to stay 7f at Goodwood; proved well suited by the drop to 5f at Sandown last week, powering home to win by over 2l; this is much tougher but she still has potential.
runners.comment: Improved effort dropped to 5f last week; this is tougher but she's unexposed at the trip

runners.name: Angels Lane
runners.spotlight: Sprang a 33-1 surprise in a soft-ground maiden at Chepstow (5f) on her debut in June; confirmed there was no fluke about that success when beaten a nose over C&D in the Super Sprint four weeks ago but that form isn't working out and this will demand more.
runners.comment: Debut win was followed by a near miss in the Super Sprint here last month; this is harder

runners.name: Lover Girl
runners.spotlight: Won her first two starts before finishing a creditable third in a York Listed race; well beaten at Royal Ascot but a revival isn't out of the question for last year's winning connections.
runners.comment: Two wins and a Listed third before a heavy defeat at Royal Ascot; needs a full revival

runners.name: Sexy Chick
runners.spotlight: Finished in front of Acting Lady at Newmarket in June; stretched by 7f next time but she made no mistake back at 6f two weeks ago, keeping on well to win a Newmarket novice; improvement required now dropped to 5f for the first time.
runners.comment: Promise over further, off the mark at Newmarket (6f) two weeks ago; needs more for 5f

runners.name: Blue Flight
runners.spotlight: Made a winning debut at Yarmouth (6f, good to firm; form worked out) and confirmed herself a useful filly when fourth, conceding a penalty, in a useful novice at Ascot (6f, good to firm; first and third run in earlier races on the card) three weeks ago;  needs more for the drop in trip but it is not out of the question.
runners.comment: Two good runs in 6f events this summer; more to come and drop to 5f should be fine

runners.name: Dubai Charm
runners.spotlight: A win and a third in 5f nurseries at Yarmouth this summer; can win more races but she is in much deeper this time.
runners.comment: Two good nursery runs at Yarmouth this summer but she is flying higher today

runners.name: Wateera
runners.spotlight: Beaten as odds-on favourite at Windsor on Monday; dropping to 5f could help but others have achieved much more.
runners.comment: Beaten at odds-on on Monday; drops to 5f with a big personal best required

runners.name: Havana Lightning
runners.spotlight: Disappointed as favourite on her Newmarket debut but made amends at Yarmouth (5f, good) on her second start; struggled at Royal Ascot but this should be easier; now fitted with a tongue-tie.
runners.comment: Yarmouth win confirmed she is useful; tongue-tie fitted after low-key run at Royal Ascot

runners.name: Cosmic Mystery
runners.spotlight: Clear promise in her two completed starts but she will need a good jolt of improvement to feature at this level.
runners.comment: Promise in her two completed starts but she will need a good deal more to take this

races.race_name: Christopher Smith Associates LLP Handicap

runners.name: Lyra Lea
runners.spotlight: 7f AW win as a 2yo; on the up in handicaps this summer, keeping on well to beat five rivals at Sandown (7f, good to firm) three weeks ago; 4lb higher in a stronger race but Oisin Murphy takes over for the first time and he has a good record for the stable.
runners.comment: Kept on well to win at Sandown last month; up 4lb in a better race but Oisin Murphy booked

runners.name: Zatsgood
runners.spotlight: Progressive on AW since handicapping, winning at Lingfield and placed at Kempton and Newcastle (all 1m) on his last two starts; flopped on turf (1m2f, good) in between but reportedly unsuited by going which the trainer's representative felt was slower than advertised; cheekpieces on now dropping to 7f; could still have more to offer.
runners.comment: Has to prove himself on turf but he's been progressive on AW; new headgear tried this time

runners.name: Assaranca
runners.spotlight: Ran out the comfortable winner of a 7f handicap at Lingfield in May; highly tried since and she has come up short; others perhaps better treated.
runners.comment: Easy 7f win in May but highly tried since and she has come up short; others appeal more

runners.name: Lightning Polka
runners.spotlight: Looked good when winning at Haydock (6f, good) on her 2yo debut but beaten in six subsequent starts; unexposed over 7f and this is weaker than the Class 3 C&D event in which she finished fourth of six (sent off favourite) four weeks ago; not discounted.
runners.comment: Two solid efforts since upped to 7f but she will need more if she is to come out on top
runners.owner: HM The King & HM The Queen

runners.name: Walson's Law
runners.spotlight: His cosy C&D win last summer came off 2lb lower; two good runs and two lesser efforts this season; should give it a good go.
runners.comment: C&D winner last summer; not beaten far at Ascot last time; each-way shout
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Lady Cobham

runners.name: Stratocracy
runners.spotlight: Ended 2025 with a 7f win at Chelmsford and he has run well in competitive handicaps on turf this summer, most recently finishing third of 18 at York (7f, good to firm) three weeks ago; no obvious reason why he wouldn't make another bold bid.
runners.comment: Running with credit in competitive turf handicaps this year; should make another bold bid
runners.owner: Total Asbestos Solutions Ltd & A Frost

runners.name: Media Legend
runners.spotlight: No significant improvement for the switch to a handicap here (1m, good) in May but that was his first run after a break and he showed clear promise as a 2yo; still has time to deliver something more potent.
runners.comment: Midfield on handicap/seasonal debut here (1m) in May; still has time to do better

races.race_name: Seamus Byrne Electrical Chase

runners.name: Rocky's Diamond
runners.spotlight: Grade 2 winning hurdler had seemingly lost way over fences and hurdles but regained the winning thread back over timber at Kilbeggan six days ago; that was a weak race but it should have boosted his confidence so leading claims now back over fences.
runners.comment: Grade 2 winning hurdler, won weak race over timber latest, major claims back over fences

runners.name: Thecompanysergeant
runners.spotlight: 3-14 over hurdles; has only managed one win over fences but has often run well in defeat; has the ability to figure here but has never won beyond 19.5f and he's got stamina questions to answer over this far a trip.
runners.comment: 3-14 over hurdles, one chase win, has the ability to figure here but stamina a big query

runners.name: Rodeo Joe
runners.spotlight: 0-5 in points and pulled up in four of them; pulled up on hurdles debut at Cork in July 2025 and beaten 50l when completing in a maiden hurdle at Roscommon 10 days ago; visor goes on for chase debut; impossible to fancy.
runners.comment: 0-5 and pulled up four times in points, hurdles form poor, visor on for chase bow

runners.name: More Coko
runners.spotlight: Has won a bumper here, a maiden hurdle here and a novice hurdle at Carlisle, all at around 2m1f; yet to prove he stays this sort of trip and has jumped left at times in most recent chase starts; off since heavy handicap defeat at Fairyhouse in April.
runners.comment: Bumper and hurdles winner, best form at around 2m1f, off since heavy defeat in April

runners.name: Anyway
runners.spotlight: Talented chaser on his day who was placed at the Cheltenham Festival in 2025; won a beginners' at Kilbeggan last year but both runs in 2026 have not been his best; pulled up when last seen at Punchestown in May; needs a revival.
runners.comment: Talented on his day, pulled up when last seen at Punchestown in May, needs to revive

races.race_name: I.P.R.S. Handicap Chase

runners.name: U Asking Me
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; on long losing run and hasn't looked like ending the barren spell in recent outings; others preferred.
runners.comment: On long losing run, in poor form this year, others make more appeal; reserve

runners.name: Bob The Builder
runners.spotlight: Point winner is 0-15 under Rules; decent run in Downpatrick handicap hurdle on debut for this stable on latest (2m6f, good); place chance if repeats that in his first handicap chase; cheekpieces return.
runners.comment: Decent run over hurdles latest, place chance with a repeat on handicap chase bow

runners.name: Fr Gilligansvoyge
runners.spotlight: Veteran; won at Downpatrick in June off 3lb lower and has held form well since; weakened late at Wexford last time (24.5f, good); drops in trip and was runner up to Menas Miracle here in June; chance.
runners.comment: Won off 3lb lower in June, trip possibly too far latest, has C&D form, player

runners.name: Menas Miracle
runners.spotlight: Bolted up over C&D here in May (Fr Gilligansvoyage second) but pulled up in follow up bid off 5lb higher at Wexford; needs to bounce back but boasts course form figures of 221 so that's not impossible.
runners.comment: C&D win on penultimate, pulled up at Wexford on latest, could bounce back

runners.name: Our Zebo
runners.spotlight: 3-15 over hurdles (including a win here) but remains a maiden over fences after four runs; ran okay off this mark over C&D last August but lacks a recent run and is best watched unless the market speaks.
runners.comment: 3-15 over hurdles, 0-4 over fences, ran okay over C&D last August, watch unless backed

runners.name: Dunany Point
