runners.spotlight: 1-16 over hurdles; ran well over an inadequate trip in a Wexford handicap chase (15.5f, good) on latest; best form is at around 2m4f so this trip might just stretch him.
runners.comment: 1-16 over hurdles, ran well in h'cap chase at Wexford latest, best form at around 2m4f

runners.name: Amburana
runners.spotlight: Produced one of her better efforts in a handicap chase at Wexford on latest but was still beaten over 12l in fourth; same mark here and more needed if she is to shed the maiden tag.
runners.comment: Beaten over 12l at Wexford on latest, same mark here, needs more to get head in front

runners.name: Corkbeg
runners.spotlight: 2-25 over hurdles but 0-7 over fences and yet to trouble the judge; soundly beaten in this race in 2024; 8lb lower now but others make more appeal.
runners.comment: 0-7 over fences and yet to trouble the judge, soundly beaten in this in 2024

runners.name: My Cullen
runners.spotlight: Maiden is 0-5 over fences but shaped like his turn was near when narrowly denied at Kilbeggan (20.5f, good) last time; this longer trip fine and should be in the mix again off 2lb higher.
runners.comment: Narrowly denied at Kilbeggan latest, this longer trip fine, in the mix again

runners.name: Set The Tone
runners.spotlight: Winning hurdler beaten 21l in that sphere on latest; pulled up and beaten 28l in two previous chase starts, albeit those were over inadequate trips; rated 7lb lower over fences so not dismissed.
runners.comment: Beaten 21l over timber latest, 0-2 in chases but rated 7lb lower, can't fully dismiss

runners.name: Robin Elite
runners.spotlight: Point winner has yet to show much under Rules; beaten 47l when midfield at Killarney latest and runs off the same mark here; not easy to make a case for.
runners.comment: Point winner, poor form under Rules, beaten 47l on latest, same mark here

runners.name: Mercurial Sea
runners.spotlight: Has run well in defeat on occasion over hurdles, including on latest at Downpatrick in a 2m2f mares' maiden; now makes chase debut with stamina to prove for this trip.
runners.comment: Has run okay in defeat over hurdles, makes chase debut now, stamina to prove

runners.name: Thewaybackhome
runners.spotlight: Running well over hurdles this summer; beaten just 4.25l when second at Kilbeggan on latest; however, jumping has lacked fluency at times so will need to improve in that department on chase bow.
runners.comment: Chase debutant, in decent form over timber but jumping has lacked fluency at times

runners.name: Not So Serious
runners.spotlight: Ended sequence of three pulled up efforts when off the mark over hurdles in first-time cheekpieces (retained) at Ballinrobe on latest (2m6f, good) when a 50-1 shot; 7lb higher for chase debut; can't be discounted.
runners.comment: 50-1 win over hurdles on latest, 7lb higher for chase debut, can't discount

races.race_name: Majestic Hotel Maiden Hurdle

runners.name: Chasing Blues
runners.spotlight: Gradually getting the hang of things over hurdles; produced his best run yet when almost making all at Wexford last time (RPR 114); a repeat of that may suffice here.
runners.comment: Best effort yet when almost making all at Wexford last time, a repeat of that may suffice

runners.name: Simple Things
runners.spotlight: 4yo filly holds an experience edge; has placed in a couple of handicap hurdles and is rated 107; far from disgraced in decent mares' handicap hurdle at Galway last time out; big player getting lots of weight back in maiden company.
runners.comment: 4yo filly, rated 107, gets all the allowances, experience edge, solid run at Galway latest

runners.name: World As One
runners.spotlight: Beaten favourite in both bumpers and on hurdling debut at Roscommon; best run to date when a 1.5l third of 13 in a maiden hurdle at Ballinrobe (17.5f, good) 24 days ago; should be thereabouts again with a repeat of that.
runners.comment: Best run yet a 1.5l third at Ballinrobe on latest, thereabouts with a repeat

runners.name: O'Callaghan Can
runners.spotlight: Has displayed ability in a Kilbeggan bumper and when a 5.75l third of 12 on hurdling debut at Downpatrick (2m6f, good) in July; remote fourth upped in trip at Kilbeggan latest and now drops markedly back in distance; place shout.
runners.comment: Has shown ability, good third at Downpatrick in July, big drop in trip here, place chance

runners.name: Jury Foreman
runners.spotlight: Has attracted market support a couple of times but extended record to 0-7 when beaten favourite in this headgear off 96 in a handicap at Wexford on latest; hard to fancy back in a maiden after that tame effort.
runners.comment: 0-7, beaten fav' off 96 in Wexford maiden hurdle latest, hard to fancy back in maiden

runners.name: Fortis Et Liber
runners.spotlight: Not much impact in point-to-points and while he did finish second on his Rules' debut in a Downpatrick maiden hurdle, he was 31l behind the winner; needs to improve on that.
runners.comment: 0-5 in points, beaten 31l when runner up at Downpatrick, needs to improve on that

runners.name: Isthatrightkatie
runners.spotlight: Has looked limited in two bumper runs and was tailed off in a 1m4f Curragh maiden on the Flat on latest; can only watch on hurdling debut.
runners.comment: Limited in two bumpers and in a Flat maiden latest, can only watch on hurdles bow

runners.name: The Orphan Girl
runners.spotlight: Point-to-point winner made a modest start under Rules when beaten 52l at odds of 80-1 at Cork; others make more appeal.
runners.comment: Point winner, 80-1 and tailed off at Cork on Rules' debut, others appeal more

runners.name: Nothintodowithme
runners.spotlight: 100-1 and pulled up on debut in a Ballinrobe maiden hurdle; hard to fancy on that evidence.
runners.comment: Huge odds and pulled up on debut at Ballinrobe, hard to fancy after that

runners.name: Champ Young
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten on debut at Navan in December and again in a 4yo maiden hurdle at Kilbeggan (2m3f) three weeks ago; needs more dropped back in trip.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten at Navan in Dec' and Kilbeggan latest, more needed back in trip

runners.name: Hashtag Doyen
runners.spotlight: No impact in point-to-points and heavy defeat on sole previous start over hurdles in 2024; hard to fancy.
runners.comment: 0-3 in points, heavy defeat when tried over hurdles in 2024, hard to fancy

races.race_name: John Fairbrother Memorial Mares Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Small Bucks
runners.spotlight: Gained a second career win on penultimate at Downpatrick (2m2f, good); hiked up 8lb and soundly beaten in much deeper race at Galway; this is easier but has never won off this high a mark.
runners.comment: Up 8lb for Downpatrick win, soundly beaten at Galway on latest, on tough mark

runners.name: Sea Of Doubt
runners.spotlight: Won off 9lb lower on seasonal return at Downpatrick (2m2f, good) in May; was holding form well over hurdles and fences since before unseating early in a handicap chase at Galway on latest; has run well over C&D before; place chance.
runners.comment: Up 9lb for May's win at Downpatrick, has run well here before, place chance

runners.name: Galileo Springs
runners.spotlight: Maiden hurdle winner; hasn't run over hurdles since October but has had a couple of recent runs on the Flat so won't be lacking for fitness; could go well back over timber.
runners.comment: Maiden hurdle winner, fit from a couple of recent Flat runs, may go well back over timber

runners.name: Tingarran Express
runners.spotlight: Won this last year off 2lb lower; shaped okay at Clonmel on last start in this sphere in June; poor over fences at Wexford latest but may rebound returned to timber at a venue she likes.
runners.comment: Won this last year off 2lb lower, poor over fences latest but could bounce back

runners.name: Rare Times
runners.spotlight: Modest form in maidens and his third on handicap bow at Kilbeggan (2m3f, good) was a remote one; just 1lb lower now and will need more dropped back in distance.
runners.comment: Remote third on handicap debut latest, eased just 1lb, more needed back in trip
runners.owner: Gerard Mullins & Ms Mary Mullins & Ms Margaret Mullins

runners.name: Cinnabar Moth
runners.spotlight: Maiden wasn't beaten that far at Wexford on penultimate but she didn't back that up back there on latest, beaten when making a bad mistake two out; eased 1lb but others hold stronger claims.
runners.comment: Maiden ran okay on penultimate, didn't back it up on latest, others make more appeal

runners.name: Bravewhenineedtobe
runners.spotlight: Started out with this yard; won a handicap hurdle at Stratford for Alistair Ralph when last sighted in August 2024; can only be watched on first run back after such a long layoff.
runners.comment: Off since Stratford win in 2024, best watched on first run after long layoff

runners.name: Del Boys Diva
runners.spotlight: On a hat-trick after decisive victories at Roscommon (by 7l) and Wexford (by 3l); has gone up a cumulative 20lb and moves up in grade but could still be more to come from this progressive mare.
runners.comment: Up 20lb for wins at Roscommon and Wexford, up in grade but may be more to come

runners.name: Like An Ocean
runners.spotlight: Shock 40-1 win on debut in a 2m Roscommon maiden hurdle (good); beaten 52l in Galway novice on latest; now makes handicap debut off what looks a fair mark; can't discount.
runners.comment: Won on debut at Roscommon, soundly beaten at Galway, opening mark may be fair

races.race_name: Walsh Butler Electrical Mares Maiden Hurdle

runners.name: Quiet In Bresil
runners.spotlight: Mild promise in maiden hurdles in the spring before two underwhelming efforts over fences; back hurdling after a break and on her best form has definite claims in a poor maiden.
runners.comment: Underwhelming efforts chasing in May; back hurdling and prospects on best form

runners.name: Hello Below
runners.spotlight: Placed in point-to-points, two maiden runs have been okay, 2m2f looking inadequate last time at Downpatrick; cheekpieces tried and should appreciate longer trip; one to consider.
runners.comment: Two maiden runs have been okay, this longer trip should suit and cheekpieces now tried

runners.name: Banphrionsa Alainn
runners.spotlight: Beaten a long way in a Punchestown maiden on debut for Tony Mullins in January and again on recent return at Galway festival; best watched for now.
runners.comment: Well held in both maidens, eligible for a mark after this

runners.name: Kenny's Jewel
runners.spotlight: Three moderate efforts over hurdles reflected in lowly rating; upped in trip and cheekpieces tried.
runners.comment: Three moderate efforts reflected in lowly rating; upped in trip and cheekpieces tried

runners.name: Treacys Ella
runners.spotlight: Midfield finishes in both bumpers this summer, burst blood vessel at Sligo and didn't land a blow in first-time tongue-tie at Wexford; potential improver switched to hurdles in a very weak maiden.
runners.comment: Midfield finishes in both bumpers; potential improver switched to hurdles in a weak maiden

runners.name: Mila Ballerina
runners.spotlight: Last month's Sligo bumper fifth (keen) was a small step in the right direction; now tries hurdles and will need to settle better.
runners.comment: Last month's Sligo bumper fifth was a small step in the right direction; now tries hurdles

runners.name: Road To The Sea
runners.spotlight: Struggled in two handicap attempts off lowly mark; easily opposed back in maiden company.
runners.comment: Struggled in two handicap attempts off lowly mark; easily opposed back in maiden company

runners.name: Fervida
runners.spotlight: No impact in maidens and again in three attempts in handicap company, last twice over 3m at Wexford; of little appeal.
runners.comment: Well held so far in handicaps; of limited appeal

runners.name: Lady Aquarelle
runners.spotlight: Reserve; struggling in handicaps, well held off this mark at Ballinrobe latest; new headgear combination tried on return to maiden company.
runners.comment: Struggling in handicaps, headgear combination tried on return to maiden company; reserve

runners.name: Nancy Wheeler
runners.spotlight: Heavy defeats at big odds in all three bumpers; hard to make a case for on hurdles debut but worth a market check.
runners.comment: Heavy defeats in bumpers; hard to make a case for on hurdles bow but worth a market check

runners.name: I'm Gold
runners.spotlight: Order Of St George filly dropped away quickly at halfway on debut in Cork bumper last month and always behind in Killarney maiden hurdle a fortnight later; tongue-tie now tried.
runners.comment: Well held both starts last month; tongue-tie now tried

runners.name: Thedreamistilalive
runners.spotlight: Beaten a long way in recent maidens at Kilbeggan and when none too fluent at Galway.
runners.comment: Beaten a long way in recent maidens at Kilbeggan and when none too fluent at Galway

runners.name: Queenofqueenstreet
runners.spotlight: Two poor efforts at Cork, in bumper last summer and for new yard in 2m1f mares' maiden hurdle early this month.
runners.comment: Two poor efforts at Cork, including 2m1f mares' maiden hurdle early this month

runners.name: Hunskelper
runners.spotlight: Mild debut promise in Thurles bumper last year but that hasn't been built on; well held on hurdles debut at Wexford in May.
runners.comment: Well held on hurdles debut at Wexford in May

runners.name: Room For One More
runners.spotlight: Beaten a long way in a Leopardstown bumper and in maiden hurdles at Downpatrick and when tending to jump left at Ballinrobe on Monday; much more needed but can't dismiss from top yard.
runners.comment: Tended to jump left when well beaten at Ballinrobe on Monday; much more needed

races.race_name: Comeragh Veterinary Kilmackthomas Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Tolka Row
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in C&D maiden in May and off the mark last month in 2m6f Downpatrick handicap, appreciating better ground and uphill finish for 33-1 shock success under today's rider; 6lb higher for that but conditions to suit and should go well.
runners.comment: Downpatrick winner 6lb higher for that but conditions to suit and should go well

runners.name: Ryan's Son
runners.spotlight: Maiden winner on good ground at Roscommon last summer; three runs since however have been disappointing (lame first occasion), most recently never counting in 2m4f Kilbeggan handicap last month; declining mark but others appeal more.
runners.comment: Couple of modest handicap efforts; declining mark but others appeal more

runners.name: Boston Beach
runners.spotlight: Minor promise in maidens but opening two handicap efforts have been poor, 12l off Tolka Row at Downpatrick on latest (after long absence); entitled to come on for that though.
runners.comment: Long absent until recent Downpatrick run behind Tolka Row, entitled to come on for that

runners.name: Latopix
runners.spotlight: Won over 1m4f in France; modest form in two bumpers in Britain and much the best of four attempts hurdling for current yard when good second in Punchestown mares' maiden over this trip in June (keen); chased home a 20L winner over 2m4f at Limerick on latest; one to consider on handicap debut.
runners.comment: Twice second in maidens recently; one to consider on handicap debut

runners.name: Tullyveery Lad
runners.spotlight: Five career wins include this race in 2024 (off 101) and 2m6f handicap chase at this fixture last year; light campaign this year, pick being Roscommon claiming hurdle second, most recently beaten when unseating two out in 3m Galway handicap hurdle; has to be respected given 10yo's record here.
runners.comment: Winner at last two festivals here, including this race in 2024; has to be respected
runners.owner: Pat Tennyson & N P Morrissey & Raymond Micheal Cody

runners.name: Hillstar Blues
runners.spotlight: Off the mark with narrow Thurles handicap win off 92 in November (2m, yielding to soft); has struggled since off revised mark and steps up in trip now.
runners.comment: Struggled since Thurles win; steps up in trip now

runners.name: Moonlight Paradise
runners.spotlight: Point-to-point winner, ordinary form in maiden hurdles, although one of her better efforts when fourth over 2m4f at Wexford in May (good); didn't quite see out 3m at same venue on latest in handicap and back slightly in trip here with blinkers tried.
runners.comment: Didn't quite see out 3m on latest; back slightly in trip here with blinkers tried

runners.name: Good World
runners.spotlight: Five-time hurdles winner at up to 3m, most recent coming in 2m5f Fairyhouse handicap in November; two runs this year have been poor so much more needed and probably wants easier ground.
runners.comment: Two runs this year have been poor so much more needed

runners.name: Mighty Berkshire
runners.spotlight: Much improved in first-time cheekpieces to land 2m6f handicap at recent Galway festival, coming off the pace to assert late on (good); 7lb rise seems fair and quite likely has more to offer.
runners.comment: Galway winner up 7lb but quite likely has more to offer

runners.name: Ray Gun
runners.spotlight: AW winner on the Flat; 0-6 over hurdles and has struggled so far in handicaps; fair bit to find.
runners.comment: 0-6 over hurdles and has struggled so far in handicaps; fair bit to find

races.race_name: Clem Jacob Hire INH Flat Race

runners.name: Mountain Sky
runners.spotlight: Top-class Flat pedigree; Godolphin cast-off for 40,000gns last autumn; much-improved in a tongue-tie to finish second on latest two starts, at Limerick (good) and when made plenty of use of in finishing a clear second to a favourite at Roscommon early this month (soft); sets the standard.
runners.comment: Runner-up at both Limerick and Roscommon; sets the standard

runners.name: Tale Of Intrigue
runners.spotlight: Steady improvement in first four bumpers, notably Kilbeggan third and never-nearer fourth (beaten under 3l) at Wexford last month on good ground; didn't appear to stay 2m2f at Cork last time, back to 2m on a sharper track should suit the Flat-bred sort.
runners.comment: Didn't appear to stay 2m2f at Cork last time, back to 2m on a sharper track should suit

runners.name: Long'way
runners.spotlight: Galiway mare cost 10,000euros as a yearling; fourth foal; sister to French 2m1f-2m3f hurdle/chase winner Heniway; dam placed French 2m3f hurdle, half-sister to useful 2m-2m5f hurdle/chase winner The King Of May; debutante of obvious appeal from yard which has won six of the last seven runnings of this race.
runners.comment: Debutante of obvious appeal from yard which has won 6 of the last 7 runnings of this race

runners.name: Call My Name
runners.spotlight: Affinisea gelding cost 6,000euros as a 3yo; second foal; dam maiden half-sister to 7f 2yo and useful 2m hurdler Tea In Transvaal; yard's bumper runners always respected, especially if strong in the market.
runners.comment: Yard's bumper runners always respected, especially if strong in the market

runners.name: Charles Kickham
runners.spotlight: Pick of three bumper runs when fourth of eight in a first-time hood at Killarney last month (good); didn't land a blow at Roscommon last time, however.
runners.comment: Didn't land a blow at Roscommon last time but place claims on previous Killarney fourth

runners.name: No Pass Port
runners.spotlight: Harzand half-sister to winners Phantom Gold (bumper/2m4f hurdle) and Parisian Fashion (2m4f hurdle); dam useful bumper and 2m/2m1f hurdle winner; 66-1, never sighted on recent debut at the Galway festival; probably best watched for now.
runners.comment: 66-1, never sighted on recent debut at the Galway festival; probably best watched for now

runners.name: Cloneen To The Max
runners.spotlight: Point-to-point winner but form in bumpers and maiden hurdles modest.
runners.comment: Point-to-point winner but form in bumpers and maiden hurdles modest

races.race_name: Zyn Frontrunner EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B-D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Necromancer
runners.spotlight: Bangkok filly out of a bumper, 2m hurdle and 1m4f AW (RPR 82) winner from just four starts; weak 10-1 shot for a C&D maiden last month but she made some late headway and was only beaten around 3l in fifth of ten; should know more this time and she's a key player for in-form yard.
runners.comment: Bangkok filly who made a promising start when fifth over C&D last month; key player

runners.name: Pressured
runners.spotlight: 55,000gns foal, 32,000gns yearling; third foal; brother to 1m4f AW winner Ada Rose (RPR 57); dam runner-up 7f AW (73), sister to winners Fourth Way (6f 2yo) and Perfect Step (7f), half-sister to 6f 2yo Listed winner System, out of 6f 2yo/1m1f winner; one of two newcomers for Ed Dunlop and market should tell the tale.
runners.comment: 32,000gns yearling; one of two newcomers for Ed Dunlop and market should tell the tale
runners.owner: Honorable Earle I Mack International I

runners.name: Sontsivka
runners.spotlight: 20,000gns foal, 45,000gns yearling; fourth foal; half-brother to 6f winner Two Summers (RPR 62); dam 7f AW winner (including 2yo; 88), out of 1m winning half-sister to 1m Listed winner Token Of Love; yard 15% with 2yos this season and interesting to see how he figures in market.
runners.comment: 45,000gns yearling; yard 15% with 2yos this season and he needs watching in market

runners.name: Smash Royale
runners.spotlight: Seventh foal; closely related to 1m 2yo (RPR 66) and 2m/2m1f hurdle winner Tara Iti, half-brother to winners Hariboux (7f-1m1f including 2yo/US stakes; 97) and Chilli Queen (1m4f; 96); dam 1m2f turf/1m4f AW winner (88); already been gelded and yard is 1-24 with 2yos in recent years.
runners.comment: Already been gelded and yard is 1-24 with 2yos in recent years

runners.name: Cool King
runners.spotlight: Well held when prominent in the market in both starts, most recently when a 5l third at Epsom (7f, good to firm) last month; that was much better than his debut form but he needs to build on that; stablemate of Royal Instinct.
runners.comment: Some promise when third at Epsom but he needs to build on that

runners.name: Mount St
runners.spotlight: 23,000gns yearling; fourth foal; half-sister to winners Chica De Ciudad (French Listed-placed 7f-9.5f; RPR 103) and Ourbren (Listed-placed 1m; 90); dam unraced half-sister to US 1m2f Grade 3 winner Homerique, out of US 6f winner; plenty to like on paper and she needs a close look on debut.
runners.comment: Plenty to like on paper and she needs a close look on debut

runners.name: Royal Instinct
runners.spotlight: 58,000euros yearling; third foal; half-brother to winners Saga Gaga (9.4f/11.4f; RPR 98) and Far Ahead (7f; 77); dam 1m2f winner (70), half-sister to useful 8.6f/9.7f winner Sagely (dam of triple 6f Group 1 winner Perfect Power); yard 11% with 2yos this season and market should guide on debut.
runners.comment: 58,000euros yearling; yard 11% with 2yos this season and market should guide on debut

runners.name: Savingprivateparry
runners.spotlight: Fourth foal; half-brother to winners Loraxed (French 7f) and Montauk (Swedish 1m/8.6f); dam unraced half-sister to 1m4f Listed/2m1f Irish Cesarewitch winner The Euphrates, out of half-sister to 2,000 Guineas winner Golan; first 2yo runner for yard this season and he's probably best watched.
runners.comment: Half-brother to two winners; first 2yo runner for yard this season and he's best watched

runners.name: Admiral Leach
runners.spotlight: 50,000euros yearling; eleventh foal; closely related to two winners including Dubka (1m4f; RPR 108), half-brother to five winners including Soffika (6f; 99), Zikany (11.4f/2m; 84) and Copperplate (1m4f turf/2m AW; 66); dam 1m2f-1m4f winner (106); has quite a bit of stamina in pedigree and he could be a longer-term prospect.
runners.comment: 50,000euros yearling; has stamina in pedigree and he could be a longer-term prospect
runners.owner: Johnny Hall And Mrs David Nutting

runners.name: Mr Twig
runners.spotlight: 30,000gns brother to German 6f 2yo winner Nitaro and half-brother to winners Brave Knight (11.4f/2m Flat, RPR 88; 2m-2m3f hurdle) and Navid (1m6f; 79); withdrawn after getting unruly in the stalls at Ascot (33-1) last month and he's been gelded since.
runners.comment: Withdrawn after getting unruly in the stalls at Ascot (33-1) and he's been gelded since

runners.name: Turtle Beach
runners.spotlight: 25-1 and was never involved when a well-held sixth of nine at Leicester (7f, good) in June; been gelded since and he needs major improvement after a short break.
runners.comment: Well held at Leicester in June and he needs major improvement; been gelded

races.race_name: Zyn Strong Stride EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Gilding The Lily
runners.spotlight: 250,000gns yearling who's a half-sister to two useful winners including Brunch (7f/1m including Listed; RPR 112); showed signs of inexperience on Wolverhampton debut (7f, AW) last month but she finished well and was only narrowly denied; should know more this time and she's open to progress on this step up in trip.
runners.comment: 250,000gns yearling; went close on AW last month and she's open to progress upped in trip

runners.name: Evening Call
runners.spotlight: 375,000gns yearling; first foal; dam French/German 9.5f-1m2f winner (including Listed; RPR 104), half-sister to German 1m2f Group 3 winner Matchwinner, out of French 1m winning sister to Irish 2,000 Guineas winner Saffron Walden; looks the part on paper and he's an interesting newcomer for William Haggas; has same owner as Date Line.
runners.comment: 375,000gns yearling; striking newcomer and he needs a close look in the market

runners.name: Date Line
runners.spotlight: Close second on Doncaster debut (7f, good) last June and she took a major step forward with a dominant display over 7f here (6-5 favourite) two weeks later; been absent since but she's bred to stay this new trip and is strongly respected under a penalty on her return.
runners.comment: Comfortable winner over 7f here last June; respected under a penalty on her comeback

races.race_name: Maritime Cargo STS Freight Frenzy Handicap

runners.name: The Sweet Escape
runners.spotlight: Progressive 4yo who won back-to-back handicaps at Beverley (7.4f, good to firm) last month before a near-miss at Galway (7f, good to soft) 13 days ago; has won over this trip in the past and he has leading claims off just 1lb higher than last time.
runners.comment: Went very close in hat-trick bid at Galway last time; leading claims off just 1lb higher

runners.name: Rising Force
runners.spotlight: Won at Doncaster (1m, good to soft) and Thirsk (1m, good to firm) in the spring and he got back to his best when going very close over C&D two weeks ago; only 1lb higher and he's a big player if he can repeat that form.
runners.comment: Two turf wins in the spring and he went very close over C&D last time; respected

runners.name: Triggerman
runners.spotlight: Sole win was on AW in 2024; well handicapped on his old form but he's been tailed off in two runs for new yard this summer and can only be watched; reapplied visor replaces cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Sole win was in 2024 and he's been tailed off in both runs for new yard this summer

runners.name: Special Ghaiyyath
runners.spotlight: Won off 9lb higher at Haydock (1m, good) last September but he's struggled for new yard this season and was a well-held fourth of five at Leicester last time; has plenty to prove and needs a big turnaround.
runners.comment: Out of sorts for new yard this season and he needs a big turnaround

runners.name: Currumbin
runners.spotlight: His two Flat wins have been over 1m6f and 2m on AW; won over hurdles at Worcester last summer but he's been generally disappointing since, including in three Flat runs this season; continues to drop down the weights but he was sixth of seven over C&D last time and others are preferred.
runners.comment: Has struggled in three runs this season and his two Flat wins have been over 1m6f and 2m

runners.name: Mr Ubiquitous
runners.spotlight: Improved his record to 6-16 when winning at Kempton (7f, AW) in March but he's been well below form in three subsequent runs; now only 1lb higher than for his last success but he needs to get back on track
runners.comment: Six-time winner but he's lost his way in last three runs; needs to get back on track

runners.name: Sir Edward Lear
runners.spotlight: Both wins have been over 1m2f and latest was at this course last August; now 2lb lower but he's been well held in both runs this season and is untried at this trip; something to prove in another switch of headgear.
runners.comment: On dangerous mark but he's been well held in both runs this season and is untried at 1m

runners.name: Calyxoh
runners.spotlight: On dangerous mark but he's generally struggled this year except for a fair third in a Chester handicap (7.6f, good) last month; had tough task in a claimer last time but he's now 1-21 and others are more convincing
runners.comment: Overall record of 1-21 and he's generally struggled this year; others are more convincing

races.race_name: Maritime Cargo STS Container Storage Solutions Handicap

runners.name: Molly Mac
runners.spotlight: Made the breakthrough at the 15th attempt when forging clear in a Nottingham handicap (6f, good to firm) last month; up 6lb but that was a clear personal best last time and she's still unexposed at this trip; key player.
runners.comment: Made the breakthrough when forging clear at Nottingham; big player again off 6lb higher

runners.name: Bayraat
runners.spotlight: Never involved in a Class 4 at York last time but this veteran was in good form before that, including a win at Wetherby (5.5f, good to firm) and three seconds; still looks on a workable mark and he has possibilities on this drop back in grade.
runners.comment: Never involved in Class 4 at York last time but this veteran was in good form before that

runners.name: Currahee
runners.spotlight: Now 1lb lower than for his Chelmsford win (7f, AW) last summer and he showed signs of a revival when fourth of ten over C&D (33-1) two weeks ago; ties in with Rebel Path on that form and he's not ruled out with cheekpieces added.
runners.comment: Showed signs of a revival over C&D latest and he ties in with Rebel Path on that form
runners.owner: J Sarkar, D Sarkar, O Sarkar & D Sarkar

runners.name: Ziggy's Condor
runners.spotlight: His sole turf win was in 2023 but he was good third at Doncaster (6f, good to firm) two weeks ago and ran to a similar level when runner-up at Southwell (6f, AW) last time; headgear is now removed but he should go well again off unchanged mark.
runners.comment: Placed on turf and AW in last two runs and he should go well again off unchanged mark

runners.name: Beauzon
runners.spotlight: Rattled off a seven-timer on the AW earlier this year; rated lower on turf but he's failed to beat a rival at Chester (5f, good) in his last two starts and is now 1-15 on grass; opposable.
runners.comment: 16-time AW winner but he's 1-15 on turf and has been tailed off in last two starts

runners.name: Fifty Nifty
runners.spotlight: Ended a long long losing run when coming from rear for a narrow success over C&D (good to firm) last week; that was a surprise at 18-1 but he's only 3lb higher under a penalty and two of his three wins have been at this track; respected.
runners.comment: Ended a long losing run when scoring over C&D last week; respected under a penalty

runners.name: Romantic Twilight
runners.spotlight: Made all for a 14-1 win in a Yarmouth nursery (6f, good) last October; that was off 5lb higher but she's struggled since that success including in three runs this season; needs a major revival.
runners.comment: Won at Yarmouth last autumn but she's lost her way since and needs a major revival

runners.name: Spirit Of Jenny
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the eighth attempt when scoring at Southwell (6f, AW) in April; creditable second at Leicester (6f, good to firm) next time but she returned from a break with a low-key effort on AW last week; may have needed that run but others are more persuasive.
runners.comment: Won at Southwell in May but she was well below form there last week; down the list

runners.name: Em Jay Kay
runners.spotlight: Five of his six wins have been on AW and latest was on Polytrack at Lingfield (6f) in January; 4lb lower here but he's struggled at Wolverhampton in last three runs and has plenty to prove back on turf.
runners.comment: Five-time AW winner but he's struggled at Wolverhampton in last three runs; lots to prove

runners.name: Mumayaz
runners.spotlight: Versatile 7yo who has won ten times at up to 1m; hasn't made an impact since his Leicester win (6f, good to firm) in May but he had lots of traffic issues at Newbury three weeks ago; can put a line through that and he's a player if he gets some luck this time.
runners.comment: Ten-time winner but he's not been at best in last four starts; needs to raise his game

runners.name: Rebel Path
runners.spotlight: His last win was 15 months ago but he made a bold when a close third off a reduced mark over C&D (good to firm) last time; responded well to first-time cheekpieces in that race and has claims if the headgear works again.
runners.comment: Turned things around with close third in cheekpieces over C&D two weeks ago; possibilities

runners.name: Northcliff
runners.spotlight: Has a patchy profile but he won at Chepstow (7f, good to firm) in May and was runner-up over this trip at Thirsk (good) 13 days ago; back up 2lb in the weights but he was clear of the third last time and has claims if he can back that up.
runners.comment: Hard to predict but he was runner-up at Thirsk last time; up 2lb but he's in the mix

races.race_name: Racing TV Handicap

runners.name: Zarathos
runners.spotlight: Won at Windsor (1m, good to firm) and York (7f, good) in May and he went close in his hat-trick bid at Epsom the following month; still looks feasibly treated on that form but he's gone off the boil in last two runs and needs to rediscover his spark.
runners.comment: Won twice in May but he's gone off the boil in last two starts; needs to get back on track
runners.owner: J Sarkar, D Sarkar, O Sarkar & D Sarkar

runners.name: Croupier
runners.spotlight: Missed almost three years before returning this spring; well held in first runs for current yard but he rallied well to finish third of 15 at Thirsk (7f, good) two weeks ago; that was much more like it and he remains well handicapped on his old form including three wins over this trip; interesting contender.
runners.comment: Returned after a mammoth absence this season but he was a good third at Thirsk last time

runners.name: Brocklesby Bill
runners.spotlight: 3yo who resumed his progress and made it 2-5 when making all in a Sandown handicap (1m, good to firm) last month; 4lb higher on this step up in grade but he had something in hand last time and could continue on an upward curve; respected.
runners.comment: Made it 2-5 when making all in a Sandown handicap last time; respected off 4lb higher

runners.name: Storm Star
runners.spotlight: All four wins have been on Newcastle AW but he's still lightly raced on turf; finished in mid-division in the Buckingham Palace at Royal Ascot (7f) last time but he was runner-up in a Class 3 there (1m, good to firm) on his penultimate run; has claims if he can recapture that form and he's in the mix back up in trip.
runners.comment: Class-dropper who was runner-up at Ascot on penultimate run; dangerous back up in trip

runners.name: Sterling Knight
runners.spotlight: C&D winner who scored on the other course here (1m, good) in May; hasn't hit the same level in four subsequent runs but he was not beaten far at Thirsk last time and he ties in with Tuscan Hills on that form; usually comes from off the pace and has possibilities if he gets the breaks.
runners.comment: Won on the other course here in May and wasn't beaten far at Thirsk last time

runners.name: Mythical Guest
runners.spotlight: Both wins were at 1m2f in 2024; good third off a reduced mark at Ascot (1m, good to firm) last month but he was only fourth of six over C&D last time; that took his overall record to 2-32 and others are preferred.
runners.comment: Only fourth of six over C&D latest and that took his overall record to 2-32; down the list

runners.name: Principality
runners.spotlight: His wins have come on good or heavy ground but he's effective on good to firm; has been and up down since his win at Glorious Goodwood last summer but he scored at Nottingham (8.3f) in May and backed that up with a creditable fifth in a big field at Epsom the following month; returns after a short break but he could go well on this drop back in grade.
runners.comment: Won at Nottingham before a good fifth in big field at Epsom; returns after 70 days off

runners.name: God Of War
runners.spotlight: Acts on fast and soft ground; hasn't been at the top of his game this season but he ran well when fifth at Chester (7.6f) in May and is now 2lb lower than for his Sandown win last summer; should be fine on this return to 1m and he's not ruled out back from a break.
runners.comment: Now 2lb lower than for his last win and he needs watching in market back from a break

runners.name: Tuscan Hills
runners.spotlight: Started his career with two wins including a Listed event in October 2024; has had some major struggles since but he's shown signs of a revival for his current yard and was beaten less than 2l at Thirsk (1m, good) last time; rallied well in that race and has claims if this sets up for his closing style.
runners.comment: Has shown signs of revival for his current yard and and he could be dangerous

runners.name: Hickory
runners.spotlight: Has a patchy profile but he got back near best with a strong-finishing success in a Class 2 handicap at Ascot (1m, good to firm) last month; that was in a bunch finish but he's only 2lb higher and is a big player if he can repeat that form.
runners.comment: Got back in groove when leading close home at Ascot last month; respected off 2lb higher

races.race_name: Racing Welfare Apprentice Handicap

runners.name: Laravie
runners.spotlight: Won three in a row in a visor this spring (1m6f-2m1f, good to firm/good) but she's been well held in last three runs and was a long way behind An Bradan Feasa at Lingfield 13 days ago; visor returns and blinkers are removed.
runners.comment: Won three in a row in the spring but she's been well held in last three runs; opposable

runners.name: Free World
runners.spotlight: Well held in three runs in Dubai last winter and on his first three starts for this yard; came in for support ahead of his first crack at this trip last Tuesday, though, when easily winning a Catterick handicap from the front; 4lb well in under a penalty and has strong claims in his follow-up bid.
runners.comment: Easy win at Catterick (2m) last week and he's 4lb well in under a penalty; strong claims

runners.name: The Craftymaster
runners.spotlight: Prolific AW winner, most recently when darting 14l clear at Wolverhampton (2m) in June; narrowly exploited lower turf mark at Lingfield (2m, good to firm) last month but he pulled clear with the runner-up and remains feasibly treated off 4lb higher; shortlisted.
runners.comment: Better on AW but he exploited a lower turf mark at Lingfield last time; respected
runners.owner: R Miles, V Miles, T Stamp & Partner

runners.name: An Bradan Feasa
runners.spotlight: Ended 2025 with a Chelmsford win (2m, AW) and he has form figures of 222 on the Flat this year; all of those runs have been in small-field events but he went close at Lingfield (2m, good to firm) last time and is on the same mark here; in the mix.
runners.comment: Went close back on the Flat at Lingfield (2m) last time and he's in the mix off same mark

runners.name: Mio Amico
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark at Lingfield (1m4f) in January and he scored by 5l at Chelmsford (1m6f) in March; another good effort when runner-up at Kempton but his form nosedived at Lingfield (2m, AW) last time; still unexposed on turf but he has bit to prove back in this sphere after a break; regular cheekpieces are removed.
runners.comment: Two AW wins this year but his form nosedived at Lingfield in May; bit to prove on return

runners.name: Tarbat Ness
runners.spotlight: Two wins at Newcastle (2m, AW) early this year and another at Carlisle (2m1f, good) last month; struggled at York last time but he had a wide draw and was badly hampered at a crucial stage; can put a line through that and he's not ruled out on this drop back in grade.
runners.comment: Won at Carlisle last month and he had an excuse at York last time; not ruled out

races.race_name: Ray And Eileen Mclean Memorial EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Final Objective
runners.spotlight: Only 2l away in the Coventry and, although a beaten favourite at Goodwood after being gelded, he didn't run at all badly in a valuable maiden; should be hard to beat.
runners.comment: Only 2l away in the Coventry and then fourth in a valuable maiden at Goodwood

runners.name: Knightbolt
runners.spotlight: 165,000gns yearling by Kodiac; first foal; dam twice-raced (RPR 65) half-sister to winners Khaloosy (smart 1m/8.6f) and Moqtarreb (1m Listed); the market should be revealing.
runners.comment: 165,000gns yearling by Kodiac; first foal; dam twice-raced (RPR 65); market revealing

runners.name: Pivotal Star
runners.spotlight: Eighth foal; closely related to German 1m winner Debit Card, half-brother to 6f winner Peter The Wolf (RPR 86); dam 5f turf 2yo/7f AW winner (67); already gelded and stable's newcomers are usually best watched.
runners.comment: Eighth foal; closely related to German 1m winner Debit Card; already gelded

runners.name: Scenic Route
runners.spotlight: 80,000euros yearling; sixth foal; half-brother to winners Jasour (5f/6f; Group 2; RPR 114) and Nightcall (French 5f); dam unraced half-sister to 6f Group 1 winner Twilight Son and 6f Group 3 winners Music Master and Run To Freedom; plenty to like on paper and entered in the Goffs Million at the Curragh.
runners.comment: 80,000euros yearling; plenty to like on paper and entered in the Goffs Million

runners.name: Novah
runners.spotlight: First foal out of a 7f AW 2yo winner (RPR 77) and half-sister to winners Saburo (5f 2yo), Blue Dune (2m) and Eagle Fang (useful 1m6f Flat and 2m-2m6f hurdle/chase); rates an unlikely winner first time out.
runners.comment: First foal out of a 7f AW 2yo winner (RPR 77); rates an unlikely winner first time out
runners.owner: D Caslin P Wilcock M Cantillon & Partner

runners.name: Les Invincibles
runners.spotlight: 35,000gns breeze-up buy; second foal; dam unplaced 6f-1m in France, half-sister to Listed winners Naturally High (1m2f), Justwantacontact (1m) and General De Vega (6f); best watched.
runners.comment: 35,000gns breeze-up buy; second foal; dam unplaced 6f-1m in France

runners.name: Melody Man
runners.spotlight: £37,000 yearling; second foal; dam 6f/7f 2yo winner (RPR 90), closely related to winners Al Aasifh (6f 2yo Listed), Invincible Gold (6f/7f 2yo) and Yalawin (6f); gelded ahead of debut but needs checking in the betting.
runners.comment: £37,000 yearling; second foal; dam 6f/7f 2yo winner (RPR 90); check the betting

runners.name: Five Star George
runners.spotlight: 9,000euros yearling; sixth foal; half-brother to 5f/6f winner Lord Roxby (RPR 89); dam unraced half-sister to Listed placed 6f-1m winner Eddie Jock and Group-placed 7f-1m2f winner Mawaakef; probably up against it on debut.
runners.comment: 9,000euros yearling; sixth foal; half-brother to 5f/6f winner Lord Roxby (RPR 89)

runners.name: Hope Of Acklam
runners.spotlight: 4,000gns yearling; first foal; dam unplaced 1m-1m4f (RPR 62), sister to North American 1m2f/1m3f Grade 2 winner Santa Monica; gelded newcomer from a yard that's doubly represented.
runners.comment: 4,000gns yearling; first foal; dam unplaced 1m-1m4f (RPR 62)

runners.name: Royal Strike
runners.spotlight: 160,000euros breeze-up buy; a market drifter on debut (9-1; 6f AW) and faded to be just over 4l behind the winner; he'll need to find plenty on that form if he's to trouble Final Objective.
runners.comment: Will need to find plenty on debut form if he's to trouble Final Objective

runners.name: Blue Faith
runners.spotlight: £100,000 yearling by Blue Point; slowly away and finished last at Doncaster (6f; 18-1).
runners.comment: £100,000 yearling by Blue Point; slowly away and finished last at Doncaster (6f; 18-1)

races.race_name: JW 4x4 Northallerton Irish EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: National Honour
runners.spotlight: Wootton Bassett colt who cost 180,000euros as a yearling; made his debut over 6f at Newmarket last month and looked ready for 7f that day, going down by 2l to a filly with experience; clear claims.
runners.comment: Second to an experienced filly on Newmarket debut; seemed to get outpaced over 6f

runners.name: Varzi
runners.spotlight: 170,000euros yearling; absent since May when making his debut at York (5f, good; also tongue tied) and no disgrace in being no match for Cut A Dash who went on to finish fourth in the Coventry at Royal Ascot; this colt is presumably held in some regard to have gone off 2-1 that day and he's also in the Group 2 Mill Reef.
runners.comment: Beaten by a good horse when favourite at York in May; has a Group 2 entry

runners.name: Meccapulco
runners.spotlight: 37,000euros yearling; fourth foal; half-sister to 7f/1m AW 2yo winner Irrelevant (RPR 65); dam lightly raced maiden (66), closely related to 9.4f Group 3 winner Jack Naylor; the only filly running and unlikely to provide the answer to this first time out.
runners.comment: 37,000euros yearling; fourth foal; half-sister to 7f/1m AW 2yo winner Irrelevant (RPR 65)

runners.name: Work Like Hell
runners.spotlight: 95,000gns yearling; third foal; closely related to 7f winner Nakeeb (RPR 91); dam French 1m/1m1f Listed-placed winner (96); would need to be pretty useful to make a successful debut.
runners.comment: 95,000gns yearling; third foal; closely related to 7f winner Nakeeb (RPR 91)

runners.name: Gold Key
runners.spotlight: 62,000euros yearling; 22-1 chance when a fader at Newcastle (6f AW) and had to show more.
runners.comment: 62,000euros yearling; 22-1 chance when a fader at Newcastle (6f AW) and had to show more

runners.name: Breaking The Habit
runners.spotlight: Behind horses from top yards at Catterick (7f; 125-1) but he was near enough 10l off the winner and that run was nothing to get excited about.
runners.comment: 125-1 at Catterick when beaten in the region of 10l

races.race_name: Heineken 0% Handicap

runners.name: Managing Director
runners.spotlight: Won his nursery over C&D (good to firm) off only 1lb lower; missed all of 2025; sharper for his comeback run, he was up there throughout when a close third in a Class 4 at York 20 days ago; every chance.
runners.comment: He was up there throughout when a close third in a Class 4 at York 20 days ago

runners.name: Winchurch
runners.spotlight: Shot up the weights for winning three races in five starts and he finished down the field at Glorious Goodwood (6f); others might be better in.
runners.comment: Good season has seen a rise in the weights and was well held at Glorious Goodwood
runners.owner: SBK Racing & B & J Parr Racing Ltd

runners.name: Emerald Harmony
runners.spotlight: Consistent mare in a good run of form and from off the pace she was only a length behind Managing Director in a big field at York last time (5f); solid chance.
runners.comment: Only a length behind Managing Director in a big field at York last time (5f); solid chance

runners.name: Rock Of England
runners.spotlight: Prominent racer and another of these having a good season; close up behind Accrual and Moulin Booj here last time and he's better off at the weights with both.
runners.comment: Close up behind Accrual and Moulin Booj last time and better off at the weights with both

runners.name: Equity Law
runners.spotlight: Off a reduced mark he won a 5f handicap at Pontefract (good ground) 54 days ago; still has handicapping scope off 3lb higher.
runners.comment: Pontefract winner last time who still has handicapping scope off 3lb higher

runners.name: Hover On The Wind
runners.spotlight: Beat the same horse in bagging two Class 5s at Pontefract (both by a length) but he trailed home last there four weeks ago in a Class 3; might be high in the weights now.
runners.comment: The hat-trick bid came up well short and he might be high in the weights now

runners.name: Our Absent Friends
runners.spotlight: Prominent throughout from a good draw at Catterick and won well; however, that was a Class 6 and he's up 6lb.
runners.comment: Recent Catterick winner but that was a Class 6 and he's up 6lb

runners.name: Accrual
runners.spotlight: His career win number six when making all and repelling Moulin Booj on recent stable debut over C&D; likely to win more races; up 4lb.
runners.comment: Career win number six when making all and repelling Moulin Booj on stable debut over C&D
runners.owner: Miss K Padgett And Mrs S D Pearson

runners.name: Moulin Booj
runners.spotlight: Right behind Accrual here before justifying favouritism at Nottingham (5f) three days ago despite an awkward start; the penalty might just find him out.
runners.comment: Ultra-consistent and a winner three days ago, but the penalty might find him out

races.race_name: Andrew Seaton Celebration Cup Handicap

runners.name: Return Of The Gods
runners.spotlight: Progressed again to edge out a reliable yardstick at Doncaster (7f; 4lb lower) but then only fourth at York; that was a bit disappointing given he was made favourite but this is only his seventh race.
runners.comment: Doncaster win reads well; bit disappointing at York but only having his seventh race

runners.name: Shadow Run
runners.spotlight: 0-6 in Ireland with one notable effort; joined this yard for 5,500gns and made a positive start when runner-up at Doncaster (7f, good to firm); now goes in cheekpieces and his best Irish run was in blinkers.
runners.comment: Second on yard debut and the return of headgear could be a positive move
runners.owner: L Bond, Sheikh Aymen Al Hamandi, J Catling

runners.name: Derrygarran Lad
runners.spotlight: Closely matched with Indefensible on last month's clash in a maiden (7f) but this gelding has lower mileage than his conqueror and cheekpieces now go on; might well reverse those placings and be involved.
runners.comment: Closely matched with Indefensible but this gelding has lower mileage

runners.name: Zarvali
runners.spotlight: Won a Catterick novice (7f, good) on seasonal/stable debut in May and following handicap runs were respectable; the last two less so and needs to bounce back.
runners.comment: Was coming along okay until finishing down the field in his last two handicaps

runners.name: Raging Raj
runners.spotlight: Ended time for Jane Chapple-Hyam by making all in 7f Yarmouth handicap (good to firm) and then sold for 30,000gns; beaten 6l on yard debut at York when behind Return Of The Gods.
runners.comment: Beaten 6l on yard debut at York when behind Return Of The Gods

runners.name: Indefensible
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the tenth attempt at Redcar (7f) when pretty much all out to deny Derrygarran Lad in a maiden; 0-3 in handicaps off this mark and 1lb higher.
runners.comment: Recent maiden winner; 0-3 in handicaps off this mark and 1lb higher

runners.name: Substance
runners.spotlight: Sole win in six races for Joseph O'Brien came in a Roscommon handicap over slightly further in May (good); final run for that yard wasn't too bad and was sold on for 28,000gns; could be the type who does well for Mark Walford.
runners.comment: Lightly raced handicap winner in Ireland; could be the type who does well for Mark Walford

runners.name: Enchant
runners.spotlight: Cost £300,000 as a breezer but it was a week three-runner novice she won last season (narrowly; 6f) and it wasn't a great novice in which she finished a fairly close sixth on her reappearance two months ago (7f, good; penalised); this mark is no gift on what she's achieved but clearly open to improvement.
runners.comment: This mark is no gift on what she's achieved but clearly open to improvement

races.race_name: Malton Marquees Racing Through The Summer Handicap

runners.name: Military Leader
runners.spotlight: Consistent dual winner who coped well with the rise in class when pushing a well-handicapped winner all the way at Ayr six days ago (1m, good; goes on all surfaces); not ideally drawn out in 15 but plenty to like otherwise.
runners.comment: Not ideally drawn out in 15 but plenty to like otherwise in current vein of form

runners.name: Donna Nook
runners.spotlight: A half-length too good for Jesmond Dawn at Ripon in early June when only 1lb lower; hasn't been overly threatening in her last three races.
runners.comment: Ripon winner in early June but hasn't been overly threatening in her last three races.

runners.name: Harswell Ruby
runners.spotlight: One of two wins came over C&D (April); some good runs in the meantime and has a handy draw to work from.
runners.comment: One of two wins came over C&D (April); some good runs in the meantime

runners.name: Travis
runners.spotlight: By no means a frequent winner (3-37) but continued his good run of form with another placed effort at Newcastle (7f; fine at 1m).
runners.comment: Continued his good run of form with another placed effort at Newcastle

runners.name: Roaring Ralph
runners.spotlight: Five wins this year (7f-1m) have come at a cost mark-wise and has to bounce back from below-par run at York three weeks ago (jockey said he ran flat).
runners.comment: Five wins this year (7f-1m) have come at a cost mark-wise; ran flat last time

runners.name: Style Of Life
runners.spotlight: Three wins from an extended 7f to 1m for current yard; perhaps needed the run on seasonal debut but could still have shown more and has had another three months off.
runners.comment: Capable but made a quiet reappearance in May and had three months off since
runners.owner: Rise One Racing - Style Of Life

runners.name: Up The Jazz
runners.spotlight: Closely matched with Jesmond Dawn on last month's runs at Ripon and it wasn't going to be easy in a Class 4 at York last time (33-1); this is more his level.
runners.comment: It wasn't going to be easy in a Class 4 at York last time (33-1); this is more his level

runners.name: Degale
runners.spotlight: Novice winner in 2024; his form has dipped quite markedly since a good run in defeat at Nottingham in May.
runners.comment: Form has dipped quite markedly since a good run in defeat at Nottingham in May

runners.name: Jesmond Dawn
runners.spotlight: Narrowly repelled Up The Jazz at Ripon (1m, good) but only fifth off this career-high mark (5lb rise) back there a month ago; he's been a bit up and down this season.
runners.comment: Narrowly repelled Up The Jazz at Ripon but he has been rather up and down this season

runners.name: Palmarian
runners.spotlight: Overcame trouble to win at Leicester (1m) and nearly followed up at Doncaster; reportedly ran too freely there last time; could be given another chance off what remains a fair mark.
runners.comment: Too free last time and could be given another chance off what remains a fair mark
runners.owner: MDP Racing And Mrs R Carr

runners.name: Bloodsweatandtyres
runners.spotlight: 7f novice winner; it wasn't too bad a run when beaten 3l on the AW last time (7f) and he's down in grade over a longer trip; not discounted.
runners.comment: Fair effort on the AW last time (7f) and he's down in grade over a longer trip

runners.name: Miss Willows
runners.spotlight: Ended last season with a win and suddenly back to form two months ago when a clear second at Beverley (extended 7f; good); however, she's far from certain to follow one good run with another.
runners.comment: Just denied last time at Beverley but far from certain to follow one good run with another

runners.name: Mount King
runners.spotlight: Four-time winner at Pontefract where he's been bang there in his last two races; his only other win was over this C&D so looks a player.
runners.comment: C&D winner who has been very competitive in last two races at Pontefract

runners.name: Alessia Fernanda
runners.spotlight: No match for the winner last week at Pontefract (1m) but that was a return to form of sorts; has dropped to what should be a good mark.
runners.comment: No match for the winner at Pontefract (1m) but that was a return to form of sorts

runners.name: Green Pursuit
runners.spotlight: Only 1-16 and he's 3lb higher than the mark he won off in April 2025, despite since going 0-11; hasn't been running badly but looks vulnerable once more; effective in this returning headgear combination.
runners.comment: 3lb higher than the mark he won off in April 2025, despite since going 0-11

races.race_name: Birra Moretti Handicap

runners.name: Halimede
runners.spotlight: Beaten double-digit lengths in three 1m races but hardly a surprise to see her in a different light once raised in distance for handicaps, winning by 5l at Catterick (1m4f) and four days later defying a penalty from the front at Lingfield (1m5f AW; comfortably); burdened with another penalty but that might not matter too much.
runners.comment: Doubly penalised for going 2-2 in handicaps, both fairly comfortably

runners.name: Recobella
runners.spotlight: Won over 1m2f at Ayr before her near miss there on Monday where she came from some way off the pace; could be considered a tad unlucky and gets in here off the same mark; stays this far and could give Halimede a race.
runners.comment: Perhaps unlucky not to win over 1m2f at Ayr on Monday and he stays this far

runners.name: Prince Achille
runners.spotlight: Best known for AW exploits and yet was struggling on Tapeta back in the spring; only 1-22 on turf, lacks a run and he's up against in-form 3yos.
runners.comment: Only 1-22 on turf, lacks a run and he's up against in-form 3yos

races.race_name: UAE PRESIDENT CUP SERIES (Group 3PA)

runners.name: Amir Athbah (Fr)
runners.spotlight: Finished in front of stable companion RB Tryst on his debut despite showing signs of greenness. Those traits were visible at Doncaster most recently when losing considerable ground by swerving to his right before rallying admirably near the line. This good-looking colt from a family the owners have done well with will come good at some stage, but others have achieved more at this point. (R2 W0 P2) (OR 87)

runners.name: Lella De La Gloire (Fr)
runners.spotlight: Made all to beat a subsequent Group Three winner on her debut in April at Tarbes and changed ownership after that run. Wasn't as good on quicker ground at La Teste last month when she was held up. The cheekpieces go on for the first time and she can't be discounted if returning to her debut form. (R2 W1 P0) (NOR)

runners.name: Eljas Du Bienn (Ity)
runners.spotlight: Made all to win at Tarbes on the same card as Lella De La Gloire on his debut in a very similar time. Has finished behind a subsequent Group One winner the last twice at La Teste. Firstly, when trying to make all and then, more recently, when held up on quicker ground. That is the strongest form on offer here and he was supplemented for this race last week. Getting weight from Nehmo De Carrerre he looks the one to beat. (R3 W1 P2) (NOR)

runners.name: Nehmo De Carrere (Fr)
runners.spotlight: Has looked a work in progress but arrives here two from two having quickened up well to win a Group Two race at La Teste in June. This will be the quickest ground he's encountered and he has a penalty to carry for his most recent win, but the Jockey/Trainer combination is having a stellar season in France; strong claims. (R2 W2 P0) (NOR)

runners.name: Rb Tryst (Usa)
runners.spotlight: A full sister to multiple Group 1PA winner RB Rich Lyke Me who shaped quite well on her debut at Lingfield behind Amir Athbah when it looked as though this trip was already needed. Being off over three months since that run is a little off putting and it looks a tough ask in this company. (R1 W0 P1) (NOR)

races.race_name: Prix des 20 Ans de Radio Balances (Grand Prix de Clairefontaine) (Listed Race) (Turf)
